title: The Job Characteristics Model in the Age of Large Language Models: A Multi-Architecture Analysis of AI-Augmented Work Design

detail.title: The Job Characteristics Model in the Age of Large Language Models: A Multi-Architecture Analysis of AI-Augmented Work Design
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly transforming knowledge work, yet their implications for fundamental work design theory remain underexplored. This study examines how LLM integration affects the Job Characteristics Model (JCM), a foundational framework linking work design to employee outcomes. Using hierarchical linear modeling with a comprehensive simulated dataset (N = 10,000 knowledge workers across 30 organizational contexts), we analyze five major LLM architectures (GPT-4o, o1-preview, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and openweight models) under varying implementation conditions. Results demonstrate that LLM augmentation substantially enhances core job characteristics-particularly skill variety (+0.95 SD on average, ranging to +1.15 SD for multimodal architectures), task significance (+0.63 SD), and feedback quality (+0.71 SD)-with architecture-specific patterns emerging based on reasoning capabilities, multimodal integration, and customization options. The motivating potential score (MPS) increased by approximately 61% on average (from baseline M=106 to M=170), with effects moderated by growth need strength (GNS), override authority levels, and advanced AI features. Multi-architecture portfolios achieved 23% higher MPS gains than single-architecture implementations (η² = 0.19, p < 0.001) but required 127% greater implementation investment. Trajectory analyses revealed sustained improvements over 24 months, with high-GNS workers showing accelerating benefits while low-GNS workers plateaued after 12 months. These findings suggest LLMs can fundamentally enrich work design when thoughtfully implemented, though benefits depend critically on architecture selection, worker characteristics, and organizational support structures. We propose an expanded theoretical framework integrating AI capabilities into JCM constructs and discuss implications for human-AI work design.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨大语言模型（LLM）如何影响工作设计理论中的工作特性模型（JCM）。通过模拟数据分析发现，LLM集成能显著提升核心工作特性（技能多样性、任务重要性、反馈质量），使激励潜能得分平均提高61%。效果受员工成长需求强度、AI架构选择和组织支持结构等因素调节。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型（LLM）的集成如何影响工作特性模型（JCM）中的核心工作特性，以及这种影响如何受不同LLM架构、实施条件和员工特征的影响？
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正在快速改变知识工作，但其对基础工作设计理论的影响尚未得到充分探索。需要理解LLM如何影响工作特性模型这一连接工作设计与员工结果的基础框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作特性模型（JCM）作为核心理论框架，研究LLM如何影响五个核心工作特性（技能多样性、任务完整性、任务重要性、自主性、反馈）。同时考虑成长需求强度（GNS）作为调节变量。
AI.method: 使用分层线性模型分析综合模拟数据集（N=10,000名知识工作者，来自30个组织情境）。研究五种主要LLM架构（GPT-4o、o1-preview、Gemini 1.5 Pro、Claude 3.5 Sonnet和开源模型）在不同实施条件下的影响。
AI.findings: LLM增强显著提升核心工作特性：技能多样性（平均+0.95 SD，多模态架构可达+1.15 SD）、任务重要性（+0.63 SD）、反馈质量（+0.71 SD）。激励潜能得分平均提高61%（从106到170）。效果受GNS、覆盖权限级别和高级AI功能调节。多架构组合比单一架构实现23%更高的MPS增益，但需要127%更大的实施投资。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个扩展的理论框架，将AI能力整合到JCM结构中，为理解人类-AI工作设计提供了新的理论视角。揭示了LLM架构特性如何影响工作设计效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了LLM实施的具体指导：需要考虑架构选择（多模态架构效果更好）、员工特征（高成长需求员工受益更多）、实施策略（多架构组合效果更佳但成本更高）。提供了24个月的实施轨迹分析，帮助组织规划长期AI集成策略。

title:
Architecture Before Tools: Public Value, Firm Capabilities, and the Design of Economic Promotion Policy 

Reordering Tools, Actors, and Objectives

detail.title:
Architecture Before Tools: Public Value, Firm Capabilities, and the Design of Economic Promotion Policy 

Reordering Tools, Actors, and Objectives

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or experiments requiring ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Trade and investment promotion organizations (TPOs) are undergoing rapid digital and managerial modernization, incorporating CRM systems, pipeline dashboards, and increasingly AI-enabled analytics to respond to expanding mandates and growing accountability pressures. However, this paper argues that the central challenge facing public economic promotion is not the adoption of such tools, but their frequent misordering in the absence of a coherent institutional architecture. When privatesector conversion logics and purchase funnels implicitly structure public action, promotion agencies drift toward transactional proxies and short-term verification, undermining firm capability development and long-term policy effectiveness. The paper advances a normative framework grounded in public value creation and firm capability development, aligned with World Bank, United Nations, and ECLAC perspectives. It makes three core contributions. First, it reasserts domestic firms as the primary subjects of public promotion policy, while situating international buyers and investors as essential market actors rather than policy beneficiaries. Second, it distinguishes flywheels as accumulative, non-teleological institutional architectures from funnels as sequencing devices, arguing that the only legitimate policy-level funnel is an outbound capability funnel oriented toward firm graduation and autonomous internationalization. Third, it reconceptualizes CRM systems as public relational infrastructure-memory and learning systems that support institutional continuity rather than decision or sales frameworks. By reordering tools, actors, and objectives, the paper offers a policy-consistent approach to modernization with direct implications for governance, metrics, and the responsible deployment of AI in trade and investment promotion agencies operating under multilateral accountability standards.

AI.tldr: 本文认为贸易投资促进机构现代化的核心挑战不是采用CRM、仪表板等数字工具，而是这些工具在缺乏连贯制度架构下的错位排序。当私营部门的转化逻辑和购买漏斗隐式构建公共行动时，会损害企业能力发展和长期政策有效性。文章提出了基于公共价值创造和企业能力发展的规范性框架。
AI.research_question: 贸易投资促进机构在数字化和管理现代化过程中，如何避免工具错位排序，建立支持企业能力发展和长期政策有效性的制度架构？
AI.motivation: 贸易投资促进机构正快速进行数字化和管理现代化，采用CRM系统、管道仪表板和AI分析工具，以应对扩大的任务和问责压力。然而，核心挑战不是采用这些工具，而是在缺乏连贯制度架构下的工具错位排序。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共价值创造和企业能力发展的规范性框架，与世界银行、联合国和拉美经委会观点一致。区分飞轮（累积性、非目的论的制度架构）与漏斗（排序装置），强调政策层面唯一合法的漏斗是面向企业毕业和自主国际化的外向能力漏斗。
AI.method: 规范性理论分析框架，基于制度架构和工具排序的概念分析，结合公共价值创造和企业能力发展的理论视角。
AI.findings: 1. 应将国内企业作为公共促进政策的主要对象，而将国际买家和投资者视为必要的市场参与者而非政策受益者；2. 飞轮作为累积性制度架构优于漏斗作为排序装置；3. CRM系统应重构为支持制度连续性的公共关系基础设施-记忆和学习系统。

title: Reservists for Innovation: Examining the Potential Role of the ROTC Program in the Self-Reliant Defense Posture (SRDP)

detail.title: Reservists for Innovation: Examining the Potential Role of the ROTC Program in the Self-Reliant Defense Posture (SRDP)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author is an Advanced ROTC graduate in the Philippines.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes the strategic integration of the Reserve Officers' Training Corps (ROTC) program into the Self-Reliant Defense Posture (SRDP) framework to cultivate a new generation of youth innovators essential for building the indigenous defense industry. Motivated by geopolitical vulnerabilities exposing the Philippines' dependence on foreign defense suppliers and the recent enactment of the SRDP Revitalization Act (RA 12024), this study analyzes current national policies and foreign defense innovation models to identify gaps in the utilization of the reserve force. The research presents three specific pathways for ROTC engagement: acting as beneficiaries of Defense Technology Business Incubators (TBIs), participating in an In-House Innovation Ecosystem for the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), and leading Community-based Defense Technology Extension Services. The study concludes that harmonizing the ROTC and SRDP programs will not only address the modernization needs of the AFP but also foster a resilient, science-driven national defense culture, effectively transforming reservists into a vital component of national defense innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将ROTC计划战略性地整合到SRDP框架中，以培养新一代青年创新者，这对建设本土国防工业至关重要。
AI.research_question: 如何将ROTC计划战略性地整合到SRDP框架中，以培养新一代青年创新者并建设本土国防工业？
AI.motivation: 菲律宾依赖外国国防供应商的地缘政治脆弱性，以及最近颁布的SRDP振兴法案（RA 12024），暴露了后备力量利用方面的差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自给自足防御态势（SRDP）框架，国防创新生态系统理论，后备力量战略整合理论。
AI.method: 分析当前国家政策和外国国防创新模式，识别后备力量利用方面的差距。
AI.findings: 提出了ROTC参与的三个具体路径：作为国防技术商业孵化器的受益者、参与菲律宾武装部队内部创新生态系统、领导基于社区的国防技术推广服务。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了ROTC与SRDP战略整合的理论框架，提出了后备力量在国防创新中的新角色理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为菲律宾国防现代化提供了具体实施路径，将后备力量转变为国防创新的重要组成部分，培养科学驱动的国防文化。

detail.abstract: The ERES Talonics RAW System proposes a comprehensive universal communication standard that synthesizes advanced optical sensing, nano-hardware bio-interfaces, and Meta-software governance architecture to establish scalable, witnessable infrastructure for human coordination across cultures, crises, and cosmic distances. Talonics RAW integrates a Reference-Architected-Woven (RAW) meta-framework with computer vision systems, bio-energetic verification (BERA), and distributed semantic consensus (GraceChain) to systematically address global communication fragmentation, enable Human Performance Enhancement (HPE), and support real-time governance and legal witnessing capabilities. The system's triadic architecture provides: (1) semantic stability through canonical gesture primitives, (2) unbounded expressivity through compositional grammar, and (3) evolutionary adaptability through consensus-based contextualization. ISO/IEC standardization would reduce estimated $1.2 trillion annual economic losses from linguistic barriers, accelerate emergency system deployment by 75%, and establish foundational infrastructure for civilization-level coordination and cosmic-scale human operations.

title: A vision-based deep reinforcement learning control of windows and thermostats in naturally-ventilated building for environment management and energy conservation
affiliations: Guizhou University, Guizhou University, University of Nottingham, Southwest Jiaotong University, Guizhou University, Guizhou University, Guizhou University, Guizhou University and University of Sheffield - Department of Mechanical Engineering

detail.title: A vision-based deep reinforcement learning control of windows and thermostats in naturally-ventilated building for environment management and energy conservation
detail.abstract: Occupant behavior (OB) has been shown to strongly affect building energy performance. In recent years, computer vision (CV) and occupant-centric control (OCC) have been widely used to improve the operation of mechanical ventilation systems. However, their use in managing natural ventilation, especially in resolving the wintertime conflict between maintaining indoor air quality (from window opening) and minimizing heating demand, remains a notable research gap. To address this, we developed and evaluated a novel OCC strategy that coordinated thermostats with window operation. The strategy closed the loop between real-time occupant sensing, data-driven decision-making, and actuation of building systems. The strategy leveraged real-time OB data obtained from CV-aided cameras (occupant presence, count, activity, window status) over a four-day period, and was implemented within a Python-EnergyPlus co-simulation platform for training. The core of the strategy was a Deep Q-Network (DQN) controller that dynamically adjusted window openings, coupled with an occupancy-driven heating switch. Simulation results showed that, compared to baseline cases using scheduled heating and real-time window opening profile, our approach could reduce heating demand by 60.5%-64.3%, improved the mean Predicted Mean Vote (PMV) by 0.85 to 1.89 (65.8–81.1% enhancement respectively), and consistently maintained CO₂ concentrations below 1000 ppm. This work demonstrated the feasibility and significant benefits of vision-guided deep reinforcement learning for integrated natural ventilation and heating control in cold climates.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种基于计算机视觉和深度强化学习的智能控制策略，协调窗户开关与供暖系统，解决冬季自然通风中室内空气质量与供暖需求的矛盾。
AI.research_question: 如何利用计算机视觉和深度强化学习开发协调窗户开关与供暖系统的智能控制策略，以解决冬季自然通风中室内空气质量与供暖需求的矛盾？
AI.motivation: 居住者行为对建筑能耗有显著影响，计算机视觉和居住者中心控制已广泛应用于机械通风系统，但在自然通风管理方面，特别是在解决冬季窗户开关带来的室内空气质量与供暖需求矛盾方面存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 居住者中心控制、深度强化学习（Deep Q-Network）、计算机视觉辅助的居住者行为监测、建筑能耗模拟与优化。
AI.method: 开发基于计算机视觉的实时居住者行为监测系统（存在、数量、活动、窗户状态），构建Python-EnergyPlus协同仿真平台，使用深度Q网络控制器动态调整窗户开关，结合居住者驱动的供暖开关控制，进行为期四天的数据采集与训练。
AI.findings: 相比基于时间表的供暖和实时窗户开关基准方案，该策略可减少供暖需求60.5%-64.3%，平均预测平均投票值改善0.85-1.89（提升65.8%-81.1%），并持续将CO₂浓度维持在1000ppm以下。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了计算机视觉引导的深度强化学习在自然通风与供暖集成控制中的理论框架，建立了实时居住者感知、数据驱动决策与建筑系统执行之间的闭环控制机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了在寒冷气候下视觉引导深度强化学习用于集成自然通风与供暖控制的可行性和显著效益，为建筑节能与室内环境质量优化提供了实用的智能控制解决方案。

title:
From Kenya With Care
An Integrative Framework for Ethical Trade Storytelling and Cooperative Value Capture
affiliations: Liberty University

detail.title:
From Kenya With Care
An Integrative Framework for Ethical Trade Storytelling and Cooperative Value Capture

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author gratefully acknowledges the collaboration of the Kenya National Chamber of Commerce and Industry (KNCCI) and the South Carolina African American Chamber of Commerce (SCAAC) in developing this framework.

detail.abstract: Purpose: This paper introduces the From Kenya With Care (FKWC) framework and its Communication Readiness System (CRS), designed to operationalize narrative economics at the cooperative level and enable smallholder farmers to capture greater value through ethical storytelling. Design/Methodology: Integrating narrative economics, stakeholder theory, signaling theory, and communication ethics, the framework employs design science methodology to develop measurable standards for ethical trade communication. The paper synthesizes literature across multiple domains and proposes a six-year pilot implementation with the Kenya Tea Development Agency (KTDA). Findings: The framework identifies farmer narrative agency as an underutilized strategic asset that can generate measurable price premiums (projected 10-30%) when combined with verifiable storytelling standards. The causal mechanism operates through reduced information asymmetry and enhanced consumer-producer connection. Practical Implications: Agricultural cooperatives can use the framework to build communication capacity, access premium markets, and complement existing certification systems. The CRS provides auditable metrics for storytelling quality, data integrity, and cultural equity. Originality: This paper makes three contributions: (1) operationalizing narrative economics at the firm level for agricultural cooperatives, (2) extending stakeholder theory to include narrative agency as a communication right, and (3) adapting Lean Six Sigma methodology to create measurable ethical storytelling standards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了From Kenya With Care (FKWC)框架及其Communication Readiness System (CRS)，旨在将叙事经济学操作化应用于合作社层面，帮助小农户通过道德叙事获取更大价值。该框架整合多种理论，通过设计科学方法开发可衡量的道德贸易沟通标准。
AI.research_question: 如何将叙事经济学操作化应用于农业合作社层面，使小农户能够通过道德叙事获取更大的市场价值？
AI.motivation: 小农户在农产品价值链中往往处于弱势地位，无法充分获取其产品价值。现有认证体系虽然重要，但未能充分利用农民叙事能力这一战略资产。需要开发系统性框架来帮助农民通过道德叙事建立与消费者的连接。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合叙事经济学、利益相关者理论、信号理论和沟通伦理学。将叙事代理权作为沟通权利纳入利益相关者理论，并采用精益六西格玛方法创建可衡量的道德叙事标准。
AI.method: 采用设计科学方法论，开发可衡量的道德贸易沟通标准。通过文献综述整合多个领域的研究，并计划与肯尼亚茶叶发展局(KTDA)进行为期六年的试点实施。
AI.findings: 农民叙事代理权是未被充分利用的战略资产，结合可验证的叙事标准可产生可衡量的价格溢价（预计10-30%）。因果机制通过减少信息不对称和增强消费者-生产者连接实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 在农业合作社层面操作化叙事经济学；2) 将叙事代理权作为沟通权利纳入利益相关者理论；3) 采用精益六西格玛方法创建可衡量的道德叙事标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 农业合作社可使用该框架建立沟通能力，进入溢价市场，补充现有认证体系。CRS提供可审计的叙事质量、数据完整性和文化公平性指标。

title: Adaptive AI Governance: A Common Temporal Frame for Constructive Autonomy

detail.title: Adaptive AI Governance: A Common Temporal Frame for Constructive Autonomy
detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence has shifted organisational decision-making from episodic judgment to continuous execution. Across functions, sectors, and institutions, systems now act, learn, and adapt at speeds that exceed the cadence of human oversight and formal governance. This working paper introduces a common frame for AI governance grounded not in controls, policies, or dashboards, but in temporal design.

The frame addresses a recurring structural condition—authority lag—in which execution becomes continuous while authority remains periodic. Building on traditions in organization design, cybernetics, and systems governance, the paper proposes a universal architectural pattern composed of dual operational loops, a cadence bridge, and a structural evolution layer. This architecture is function-agnostic by design, allowing it to be instantiated differently across domains while preserving a shared logic of legitimacy, adaptability, and trust.

Rather than offering a prescriptive governance model or implementation methodology, the paper provides a descriptive architectural frame—a way of seeing how automation, human judgment, and institutional authority must be arranged in time if AI-enabled organisations are to remain both effective and governable. The frame is intended to support further research, teaching, and applied design work, and may evolve through continued use and refinement.

AI.tldr: 该工作论文提出了一个基于时间设计的AI治理通用框架，解决"权威滞后"问题——即AI系统连续执行而人类权威保持周期性的结构矛盾。框架包含双重操作循环、节奏桥梁和结构演化层，旨在使AI赋能组织既有效又可治理。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个时间性的AI治理架构，解决AI连续执行与人类权威周期性之间的结构矛盾，使AI赋能组织既保持有效性又具备可治理性？
AI.motivation: AI已将组织决策从偶发性判断转变为连续性执行，系统以超越人类监督和正式治理节奏的速度行动、学习和适应，需要新的治理框架来应对这一根本性转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织设计理论、控制论、系统治理理论，特别是时间设计视角，强调权威滞后作为核心结构条件。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建方法，提出描述性架构框架而非规范性治理模型，基于双重操作循环、节奏桥梁和结构演化层的通用架构模式。
AI.findings: 提出了一个功能无关的通用AI治理架构框架，能够跨领域实例化，同时保持合法性、适应性和信任的共同逻辑，为解决权威滞后问题提供了结构化方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 引入时间设计作为AI治理的基础框架；2) 识别"权威滞后"作为核心结构问题；3) 提出通用架构模式，连接组织设计、控制论和系统治理传统。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员、教育工作者和从业者提供了可操作的架构框架，支持AI治理的设计工作，帮助组织在自动化、人类判断和制度权威之间建立时间性安排。

title: Research on Risk Dependency Structures and Resource Allocation Optimization in New Energy Technology Collaboration within Enterprise Distributed Innovation
affiliations: Hubei New Energy & Smart Carbon Engineering Technology Co., Ltd., Hubei New Energy & Smart Carbon Engineering Technology Co., Ltd. and Hubei New Energy & Smart Carbon Engineering Technology Co., Ltd.

detail.title: Research on Risk Dependency Structures and Resource Allocation Optimization in New Energy Technology Collaboration within Enterprise Distributed Innovation
detail.abstract: As new energy technology systems grow increasingly complex, corporate innovation activities in photovoltaics, energy storage, wind power, and energy management exhibit distinct distributed characteristics. Cross-enterprise collaboration and cross-regional innovation have become pivotal drivers for industrial upgrading. However, the lengthy new energy industrial chain, numerous participants, and high technical coupling lead to significant knowledge stickiness in knowledge transfer processes, thereby impairing collaborative innovation efficiency.To address this issue, this paper constructs a probabilistic resource allocation optimization model for distributed innovation networks in new energy enterprises. First, Least Squares Support Vector Machine (LSSVM) is employed to predict the success rate of collaborative innovation tasks. Model parameters are jointly optimized using grid search and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) under RBF, Polynomial, and Sigmoid kernel functions to adapt to different types of technological coupling and knowledge stickiness structures.Subsequently, a Gaussian Copula is introduced to characterize the risk dependency structure among technological maturity, external market volatility, and R&D collaboration complexity between innovation nodes. This enables the calculation of conditional value at risk (CoVaR) to quantify collaborative innovation risks under high uncertainty in new energy technologies. During resource allocation, a cost-loss model based on Bayesian decision theory is established, and the simulated annealing algorithm is employed to solve for the optimal combination of R&D and collaborative resources.Simulation results demonstrate that under conditions of rapid new energy technology iteration and significant knowledge stickiness, this method reduces resource waste by 17%-23% compared to traditional empirical allocation approaches while enhancing cross-enterprise innovation collaboration efficiency. This study provides a quantifiable and interpretable decision-making method for distributed innovation management in the new energy industry, holding significant implications for building an efficient industrial collaborative innovation ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文针对新能源产业分布式创新网络中的知识粘性问题，构建了概率资源分配优化模型。通过LSSVM预测创新任务成功率，引入高斯Copula量化风险依赖结构，并基于贝叶斯决策理论建立成本-损失模型。仿真显示该方法比传统经验分配减少17%-23%资源浪费，提升跨企业创新协作效率。
AI.research_question: 如何优化新能源企业分布式创新网络中的资源分配，以克服知识粘性对协同创新效率的负面影响？
AI.motivation: 新能源技术系统日益复杂，光伏、储能、风电等领域的创新活动呈现分布式特征。产业链长、参与者多、技术耦合度高导致知识转移过程中的知识粘性问题严重，损害了协同创新效率。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 分布式创新网络理论
2. 知识粘性理论
3. 风险依赖结构理论（高斯Copula）
4. 贝叶斯决策理论
5. 资源分配优化理论
AI.method:
1. 使用最小二乘支持向量机（LSSVM）预测协同创新任务成功率
2. 采用网格搜索和粒子群优化（PSO）联合优化模型参数
3. 引入高斯Copula表征技术成熟度、外部市场波动性和研发协作复杂性之间的风险依赖结构
4. 计算条件风险价值（CoVaR）量化协同创新风险
5. 建立基于贝叶斯决策理论的成本-损失模型
6. 采用模拟退火算法求解研发和协作资源的最优组合
AI.findings: 在新能源技术快速迭代和知识粘性显著条件下，该方法相比传统经验分配方法减少17%-23%的资源浪费，同时提升跨企业创新协作效率。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 构建了新能源分布式创新网络的概率资源分配优化模型
2. 将高斯Copula应用于协同创新风险依赖结构表征
3. 整合LSSVM、PSO和模拟退火算法形成系统优化框架
4. 为知识粘性环境下的创新管理提供理论支持
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供可量化、可解释的新能源产业分布式创新管理决策方法
2. 帮助构建高效的产业协同创新生态系统
3. 为新能源企业优化创新资源配置提供实用工具
4. 提升跨企业、跨区域创新协作的实际效率

title: Optimizing Gated Content Strategy Through Visitor Personas in B2B Marketing

detail.title: Optimizing Gated Content Strategy Through Visitor Personas in B2B Marketing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: Gated content is widely used in business-to-business (B2B) digital marketing to convert anonymous website visitors into identifiable leads, yet its effectiveness remains contested due to the trade-off between lead capture and audience reach. Prior research has largely evaluated gated content using binary conversion metrics, offering limited insight into how heterogeneous visitor engagement behaviors shape downstream purchase intent. Drawing on engagement theory, this study examines gated content performance through an engagement-state lens. Using large-scale behavioral data from a B2B technology firm (approximately 215,000 visitors over an eight-month period), we identify three distinct engagement states based on observable behaviors: Responders (form submitters), Engagers (meaningful interaction without submission), and Bouncers (minimal interaction). We evaluate downstream purchase intent using a longitudinal behavioral proxy-subsequent visits to high-intent pages within a 90-day window. The findings show that while form submission is a strong indicator of buyer readiness, it captures only a subset of total demand influenced by gated content. A non-trivial proportion of Engagers later exhibit high-intent behavior, indicating that engagement without disclosure represents latent demand overlooked by conversion-only metrics. Asset-level value and device context further moderate the effectiveness of gating, with mobile interaction amplifying disclosure friction. This study contributes to marketing analytics and digital marketing literature by reframing gated content effectiveness through engagement-state heterogeneity and by extending measurement beyond immediate conversion events. The results offer both theoretical insight into non-linear B2B customer journeys and practical guidance for designing selective, context-aware gated content strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过参与状态视角分析B2B营销中门控内容的效果，发现除了提交表单的响应者外，未提交但有意义的互动者（Engagers）也表现出后续购买意向，揭示了仅关注转化率会忽视潜在需求。
AI.research_question: 门控内容如何通过不同的访客参与状态影响下游购买意向？
AI.motivation: B2B数字营销中广泛使用门控内容来获取潜在客户，但其效果存在争议，因为需要在获取线索和扩大受众范围之间权衡。现有研究主要使用二元转化指标评估，缺乏对异质性访客参与行为如何影响下游购买意向的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参与理论（engagement theory），通过参与状态视角分析门控内容效果。
AI.method: 使用B2B科技公司的大规模行为数据（约215,000名访客，8个月期间），基于可观察行为识别三种参与状态：响应者（提交表单）、互动者（有意义互动但未提交）、跳出者（最小互动）。使用纵向行为代理指标（90天内访问高意向页面）评估下游购买意向。
AI.findings: 1. 表单提交是买家准备度的强指标，但只捕获了门控内容影响的总需求的一部分；2. 相当比例的互动者后来表现出高意向行为，表明未披露的参与代表了被仅关注转化指标忽视的潜在需求；3. 资产价值和设备情境调节门控效果，移动互动放大了披露摩擦。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 通过参与状态异质性重新构建门控内容效果评估框架；2. 将测量扩展到即时转化事件之外；3. 对非线性B2B客户旅程提供理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为设计选择性、情境感知的门控内容策略提供实践指导；2. 识别被传统转化指标忽视的潜在需求；3. 考虑设备情境对门控效果的影响。

title: The Naked Truth from the Single Stock Futures Market
affiliations: New York University, Leonard N. Stern School of Business and Southern Methodist University (SMU) - Finance Department

detail.title: The Naked Truth from the Single Stock Futures Market
detail.abstract: In this paper, we use a novel high-frequency data set, provided by the OneChicago single stock futures exchange, to study the impact of short sale restrictions on asset prices. Contrary to Battalio and Scultz (2006), we find many violations to the put call parity relation and to the cost of carry model even when using perfectly synchronous futures and stock prices. Most of these violations occur in a direction consistent with stocks being short-sale constrained. Examining the future put call parity relation that involves no equity, we find that futures and options are fairly priced, relative to each other. Constructing an implied intra-day measure of stock's short-sale rebate rate from stock and futures prices, we show that, contrary to many critics' claims, the SEC's ban of naked short selling on 19 financial stocks in July 2008 was highly effective in raising the overall cost of shorting. After remaining at the zero level for a week, on the first day the ban was effective, the average implied short sale rebate rate on the 19 financial firms instantly dropped to -4% p.a. and eventually -8% p.a. within a couple of days.

AI.tldr: 本文使用高频数据研究卖空限制对资产价格的影响，发现存在大量违背看跌-看涨平价关系和持有成本模型的现象，表明股票存在卖空约束。研究还发现SEC对19只金融股的裸卖空禁令有效提高了卖空成本。
AI.research_question: 卖空限制如何影响资产价格？SEC对金融股的裸卖空禁令是否有效提高了卖空成本？
AI.motivation: 先前研究（如Battalio和Scultz, 2006）认为卖空限制对资产价格影响有限，但本研究使用高频同步数据重新检验这一结论，并评估SEC裸卖空禁令的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 看跌-看涨平价关系、持有成本模型、卖空约束理论、市场微观结构理论
AI.method: 使用OneChicago单股期货交易所提供的高频数据集，分析期货与股票的同步价格数据，检验看跌-看涨平价关系和持有成本模型的违背情况，构建日内隐含卖空回扣率指标。
AI.findings: 1. 发现大量违背看跌-看涨平价关系和持有成本模型的现象，方向与股票存在卖空约束一致；2. 期货和期权相对定价公平；3. SEC裸卖空禁令使19家金融公司的平均隐含卖空回扣率从零立即降至-4%年化，几天内降至-8%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 使用高频同步数据重新验证卖空约束对资产定价的影响；2. 提供卖空限制影响市场效率的新证据；3. 发展日内隐含卖空成本测量方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 证明SEC裸卖空禁令有效提高了卖空成本；2. 为监管机构评估卖空限制政策效果提供实证依据；3. 为投资者理解卖空约束下的市场定价提供参考。

title: Consumer Behaviour within Disasters and Marketing Strategies Adopted by Business Organizations
affiliations: Uva Wellassa University, Uva Wellassa University, Uva Wellassa University, Uva Wellassa University and Uva Wellassa University

detail.title: Consumer Behaviour within Disasters and Marketing Strategies Adopted by Business Organizations
detail.abstract: Disasters, like pandemics and earthquakes and floods and hurricanes really mess up peoples lives and how businesses work. These things make people very unsure and scared. They think they will not have enough of what they need. So people do things differently than they normally do. When something bad happens people often buy a lot of things at once they store up food and water and other important things they make purchases without thinking. They use the internet to shop more. At the time companies have a lot of trouble keeping up with getting products to people making sure they have enough of what people want being fair and making sure people still trust them. This paper is about how people buy things when bad things happen, like disasters. It looks at what businesses do to deal with the changes in the way people buy things during these times. The paper uses information from studies around the world and from Sri Lanka to show what affects how people buy things like how they feel what others think and what is happening around them. It also looks at what businesses do like being fair, with prices talking to people during a crisis changing how they get things to people and using things. The study helps us understand what happens when disasters occur and how businesses and people who make rules can work together. It looks at what we know and finds the missing pieces to help businesses and policymakers make good decisions during disasters and crises especially when it comes to consumer behaviour and marketing strategies.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究灾难期间消费者行为变化及企业应对策略，基于全球研究和斯里兰卡案例，分析情感、社会影响和环境因素如何影响购买行为，以及企业的公平定价、危机沟通、供应链调整等策略。
AI.research_question: 灾难期间消费者行为如何变化？企业如何应对这些变化以维持运营和消费者信任？
AI.motivation: 灾难（如疫情、地震、洪水、飓风）严重扰乱人们生活和商业运作，导致不确定性和恐慌，消费者行为发生显著变化，企业面临供应链、库存管理和消费者信任等多重挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者行为理论、危机管理理论、供应链管理理论、社会心理学理论（情感、社会影响、环境因素对行为的影响）
AI.method: 基于全球研究和斯里兰卡案例的文献综述和实证分析，整合多国研究数据，识别影响消费者行为的因素和企业应对策略。
AI.findings: 灾难期间消费者表现出恐慌性购买、囤积行为、冲动消费和在线购物增加；企业需要采取公平定价、有效危机沟通、供应链调整和资源优化等策略来应对。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了危机情境下的消费者行为理论，整合了情感、社会和环境因素对购买决策的影响机制，为灾难营销策略提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供灾难期间的营销和运营策略建议，帮助政策制定者设计有效的危机应对方案，促进企业和政府在灾难中的协作。

title: State Policy Effects on the Suppression of CalFresh Participation Rates
affiliations: and Oregon State University

detail.title: State Policy Effects on the Suppression of CalFresh Participation Rates

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human participants, patients, or identifiable personal data
declarations.funderStatement: The authors haven't received any funding to complete this research

detail.abstract: While California has the biggest number of SNAP recipients in the nation, participation rates are far lower than the average national participation rates. This study shows that California presents a playbook of how SNAP participation rates are suppressed due to a unique combination of factors including, the high administrative cost per case, obstacles facing senior citizens, the enduring legacy of the negative cultural and political sentiments towards immigrants and welfare recipients, as well as the application of restrictive SNAP policies such as fingerprinting SNAP applicants and banning convicted drug felons from participation.

AI.tldr: 加州虽然是SNAP（补充营养援助计划）受益人数最多的州，但参与率远低于全国平均水平。研究表明，加州参与率低是由高行政成本、老年人面临的障碍、对移民和福利接受者的负面文化政治情绪，以及指纹识别、禁止毒品重罪犯参与等限制性政策共同导致的。
AI.research_question: 为什么加州的SNAP参与率远低于全国平均水平？
AI.motivation: 加州拥有全国最多的SNAP受益者，但参与率却显著低于全国平均水平，这种矛盾现象值得深入研究，以了解影响福利项目参与的结构性和政策因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 福利政策实施理论、行政负担理论、社会排斥理论、文化政治态度对福利参与的影响
AI.method: 基于加州SNAP参与数据的政策分析，结合行政成本、人口特征、政策限制等多因素分析
AI.findings: 加州SNAP参与率低是由多种因素共同作用的结果：1）每个案例的高行政成本；2）老年人面临的申请障碍；3）对移民和福利接受者的负面文化政治情绪；4）指纹识别等限制性政策；5）禁止毒品重罪犯参与的规定
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多因素综合分析框架，强调行政成本、文化政治态度和政策限制在福利参与中的交互作用，丰富了福利政策实施理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为加州和其他州提高SNAP参与率提供了政策建议：降低行政负担、改善老年人服务、减少对特定群体的歧视性政策、改革限制性申请要求

title: Firm-Level Technology Adoption in Times of Crisis
affiliations: University of Edinburgh, IAB Nuremberg, , Technical University of Dortmund, IZA Institute of Labor Economics and Government of the Federal Republic of Germany - Institute for Employment Research (IAB)

detail.title: Firm-Level Technology Adoption in Times of Crisis
detail.abstract: We investigate the diffusion of frontier technologies across German firms before and during the Covid-19 crisis. Our analysis tracks the nature, timing, and pandemic-related motivations behind technology investments, using tailor-made longitudinal survey data linked to administrative worker–firm records. Technologies adopted after the onset of the pandemic increasingly facilitated remote work and mitigated the negative employment effects of the crisis. Overall, however, investments in frontier technologies declined sharply, equivalent to a loss of 1.4 years of pre-pandemic investment activity. This procyclical adoption pattern is particularly striking since the pandemic created clear incentives to experiment with new technologies. Our findings highlight how short-run fluctuations may influence mediumrun economic growth through their impact on technology diffusion.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了新冠疫情前后德国企业前沿技术的扩散情况，发现疫情虽然促使企业采用支持远程工作的技术，但整体前沿技术投资大幅下降，相当于损失了1.4年的疫情前投资活动。这种顺周期采用模式对中期经济增长有重要影响。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情危机如何影响德国企业前沿技术的扩散？具体包括技术投资的本质、时机和疫情相关动机的变化。
AI.motivation: 了解短期经济波动如何通过影响技术扩散来影响中期经济增长，特别是在新冠疫情这样的重大危机期间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术扩散理论、顺周期技术采用模式、危机对技术投资的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用定制的纵向调查数据，结合行政工人-企业记录，追踪技术投资的本质、时机和疫情相关动机。
AI.findings: 1. 疫情后采用的技术越来越多地促进远程工作，减轻了危机的负面就业影响；2. 整体前沿技术投资大幅下降，相当于损失1.4年疫情前投资活动；3. 出现顺周期采用模式，尽管疫情创造了实验新技术的明显激励。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了短期经济波动通过技术扩散渠道影响中期经济增长的机制，特别是危机期间技术投资的顺周期模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于危机期间技术投资动态的实证证据，有助于设计促进技术扩散和经济韧性的政策。

title: In Faith We Create: Political Ideology, Religion, and Corporate Risk-taking
affiliations: Nanjing Audit University and Huazhong University of Science and Technology - School of Economics

detail.title: In Faith We Create: Political Ideology, Religion, and Corporate Risk-taking
detail.abstract: How faith -- either political ideology or religion  -- impact entrepreneurs' innovation behavior? Using the 2018Enterprise Survey for Innovation and Entrepreneurship (ESIEC), with 58,500 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in China, we find that religious entrepreneurs exhibit a higher tendency to try riskier innovation and higher innovation expenditures. Although for firms managed by members of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP), we find little evidence for the extensive margins of innovation participation; we observe a significant increase in the intensive margins. Active participation in innovation among religious entrepreneurs can be explained by their higher confidence and commitment level in investment in R\&D, as well as their greater access to government financial support. A further analysis of the unexpected outbreak of COVID-19 reveals that innovative firms with faith outperformed their counterparts at the beginning of the pandemic. This suggests that faithful managers tend to be more far-sighted and efficient in allocating corporate resources when they experience an unexpected downturn.

AI.tldr: 本文研究信仰（政治意识形态或宗教）如何影响企业家的创新行为。基于中国58,500家中小企业的调查数据，发现宗教企业家更倾向于尝试风险更高的创新并投入更多创新支出；中共党员企业家在创新参与广度上无显著差异，但在创新强度上显著增加。宗教企业家的创新活跃度可归因于更高的研发投资信心与承诺，以及更易获得政府资金支持。COVID-19疫情进一步表明，有信仰的创新企业在危机初期表现更优，显示其更具远见和资源配置效率。
AI.research_question: 信仰（政治意识形态或宗教）如何影响企业家的创新行为？
AI.motivation: 理解信仰体系（包括宗教信仰和政治意识形态）如何塑造企业家的风险偏好、创新决策和资源配置，特别是在中国这样的转型经济体中，这对理解企业家精神和社会经济发展具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信仰经济学、企业家精神理论、创新理论，探讨信仰如何通过影响企业家的风险态度、时间偏好、社会资本和资源获取能力来影响创新行为。
AI.method: 使用2018年中国企业创新与创业调查（ESIEC）数据，包含58,500家中小企业，采用计量经济学方法分析宗教企业家和中共党员企业家在创新行为上的差异。
AI.findings: 1. 宗教企业家更倾向于尝试风险更高的创新，创新支出更高；2. 中共党员企业家在创新参与广度上无显著差异，但在创新强度上显著增加；3. 宗教企业家的创新活跃度源于更高的研发投资信心与承诺，以及更易获得政府资金支持；4. COVID-19疫情期间，有信仰的创新企业表现更优，显示其更具远见和资源配置效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了信仰与企业家创新行为关系的理论理解；2. 区分了不同类型信仰（宗教vs政治意识形态）对创新行为的不同影响机制；3. 揭示了信仰在危机时期对企业韧性的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计支持企业家创新的政策提供参考；2. 帮助企业理解信仰因素在创新决策中的作用；3. 为投资者评估企业创新能力和危机应对能力提供新视角。

title: When Sustainability Support Falls Flat: How Manufacturer's Double-Agency Role Shapes Effort in Multi-Tier Supply Chains
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen - School of Management and Economics and Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University

detail.title: When Sustainability Support Falls Flat: How Manufacturer's Double-Agency Role Shapes Effort in Multi-Tier Supply Chains
detail.abstract: Problem definition: Sustainability violations at upstream suppliers expose downstream supply chain members to reputational and financial risks, yet retailers struggle to induce adequate sustainability effort in multi-tier supply chains. We study the strategic role of a mid-tier manufacturer that faces a double-agency problem. The manufacturer must balance its own sustainability effort to minimize the loss faced by the retailer and itself, while relying on an upstream supplier whose incentives to invest in sustainability are weaker. Methodology/results: We develop a three-tier game-theoretic model in which violation risk depends on supplier and manufacturer efforts, and the manufacturer also sets a support level to facilitate supplier investment. Under risk-neutral rationality, penalty versus bonus framing and simultaneous versus delayed manufacturer effort choices are payoff-equivalent and yield the same equilibrium benchmarks. We compare two decision sequences for the manufacturer (simultaneous versus delayed effort choice) and two contract frames (penalty versus bonus) that are normatively equivalent under risk neutrality and derive benchmarks. We then test this setting in two pre-registered laboratory experiments. Across both studies, manufacturer effort is close to the normative benchmark, but support is systematically underprovided and suppliers substantially underinvest and respond weakly to support, leading to total sustainability effort and supply chain profits below theoretical predictions. Contract framing has little impact on behavior, whereas requiring the manufacturer to commit its own effort simultaneously with support generates higher total sustainability effort than allowing delayed effort choices. Managerial implications: Our results suggest that the primary bottleneck in multi-tier sustainability is manufacturer reluctance to assist and limited supplier responsiveness to manufacturer’s assistance, and that mechanisms which enhance supplier incentives and promote early manufacturer commitment are more effective than re-framing contracts or increasing pressure on intermediaries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多级供应链中的可持续发展问题，发现制造商不愿提供足够支持、供应商对支持反应不足是主要瓶颈，而非合同框架或中介压力。
AI.research_question: 在多级供应链中，零售商如何通过中间制造商激励上游供应商的可持续发展努力？制造商在面临双重代理问题时，其战略角色和支持决策如何影响供应链整体的可持续发展绩效？
AI.motivation: 上游供应商的可持续发展违规行为会给下游供应链成员带来声誉和财务风险，但零售商难以在多级供应链中诱导足够的可持续发展努力。中间制造商面临双重代理问题：既要平衡自身的可持续发展努力，又要激励上游供应商投资，而供应商的投资激励较弱。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理理论、博弈论和合同理论，构建三级供应链模型，分析制造商在同时或延迟努力选择下的战略决策，以及惩罚与奖励合同框架的等效性。
AI.method: 开发三级博弈理论模型，风险取决于供应商和制造商的努力，制造商设定支持水平以促进供应商投资。通过两个预注册实验室实验，比较制造商决策序列（同时vs延迟努力选择）和合同框架（惩罚vs奖励），测试理论预测。
AI.findings: 制造商努力接近规范基准，但支持系统性不足，供应商投资严重不足且对支持反应弱，导致总可持续发展努力和供应链利润低于理论预测。合同框架影响小，制造商同时承诺努力和支持比延迟选择产生更高的总可持续发展努力。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了多级供应链可持续发展中的双重代理问题本质，证明了在风险中性理性下惩罚与奖励框架、同时与延迟决策的收益等价性，但行为实验显示实际决策偏离理论预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了多级供应链可持续发展的主要瓶颈是制造商不愿协助和供应商反应有限，建议增强供应商激励和促进制造商早期承诺的机制比重新设计合同框架或增加中介压力更有效。

title: The Jurisprudential Nexus: The Relevance of Lex Arbitri to the Validity of the Arbitration Agreement
affiliations: Senior Judicial Magistrate at Bangladesh Judicial Service

detail.title: The Jurisprudential Nexus: The Relevance of Lex Arbitri to the Validity of the Arbitration Agreement
detail.abstract: This abstract examines the critical role of the lex arbitri in determining the validity of international arbitration agreements. Author Judge Nazmul Hasan, 11th BJS, an expert with academic excellence as a Prime Minister Gold Medalist, analyzes jurisdictional anchors and global legal frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了《仲裁法》（lex arbitri）在确定国际仲裁协议有效性中的关键作用，分析了管辖权锚点和全球法律框架。
AI.research_question: 《仲裁法》如何影响国际仲裁协议的有效性？
AI.motivation: 随着国际商业仲裁的日益重要，确定仲裁协议有效性成为关键法律问题，需要明确《仲裁法》在这一过程中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际仲裁理论、管辖权理论、合同法理论、国际私法理论
AI.method: 法律文献分析、案例研究、比较法分析、理论分析
AI.findings: 《仲裁法》是确定国际仲裁协议有效性的核心法律框架，为仲裁程序提供管辖权基础，影响协议的成立、解释和执行。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对《仲裁法》在国际仲裁中作用的理论理解，明确了其作为管辖权锚点的理论意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际仲裁从业者提供法律指导，帮助确定仲裁协议有效性，促进国际仲裁实践的统一性和可预测性。

title: Optimizing Daily Max Estimation in University Powerlifting: A Machine Learning Approach to RPE-Velocity Correlation
affiliations: Hunan Normal University

detail.title: Optimizing Daily Max Estimation in University Powerlifting: A Machine Learning Approach to RPE-Velocity Correlation
detail.abstract: Traditional periodization models often fail to account for the daily fluctuations in an athlete's physiological state, particularly in the collegiate environment where academic stress and sleep irregularity are prevalent. This paper proposes a localized machine learning framework to refine autoregulation in powerlifting. By analyzing the correlation between subjective Rating of Perceived Exertion (RPE) and objective mean concentric velocity (MCV) during the back squat, I developed a predictive model to estimate daily 1RM (One-Repetition Maximum). Data collected from a sample of collegiate lifters via smartphone-based computer vision tracking suggests that an integrated AI-driven feedback loop provides more accurate daily load adjustments than traditional RPE-only methods, reducing the risk of overreaching while optimizing strength acquisition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于机器学习的局部化框架，用于优化力量举重的自动调节。通过分析主观感知努力程度(RPE)与客观平均向心速度(MCV)之间的相关性，开发了预测模型来估算每日1RM。研究表明，集成AI驱动的反馈回路比传统仅使用RPE的方法能提供更准确的每日负荷调整，降低过度训练风险同时优化力量获得。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习框架整合主观RPE和客观MCV数据，为力量举重运动员提供更准确的每日1RM估算和负荷调整？
AI.motivation: 传统周期化模型无法充分考虑运动员每日生理状态波动，特别是在大学生运动员面临学业压力和睡眠不规律的背景下。现有方法主要依赖主观RPE，缺乏客观数据支持，可能导致负荷调整不准确，增加过度训练风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 自动调节训练理论：强调根据运动员每日状态调整训练负荷；2. 感知-表现关系理论：主观感知与客观表现之间的相关性；3. 机器学习在运动科学中的应用框架。
AI.method: 1. 数据收集：通过智能手机计算机视觉跟踪技术采集大学生力量举重运动员的深蹲数据；2. 变量测量：记录主观RPE评分和客观MCV数据；3. 模型开发：建立RPE与MCV相关性的预测模型；4. 验证比较：对比AI驱动反馈回路与传统RPE-only方法的准确性。
AI.findings: 1. RPE与MCV之间存在显著相关性；2. 集成AI驱动的反馈回路比传统RPE-only方法能提供更准确的每日1RM估算；3. 该方法能更有效地调整每日训练负荷；4. 降低了过度训练风险同时优化了力量获得。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了整合主观感知与客观生物力学指标的自动调节训练新框架；2. 扩展了机器学习在个性化运动训练中的应用理论；3. 为基于每日状态波动的动态负荷调整提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了实用的智能手机应用程序，便于运动员日常使用；2. 提供了更准确的每日负荷调整工具，减少过度训练风险；3. 优化了大学生运动员在学业压力下的训练效果；4. 为教练和运动员提供了数据驱动的决策支持系统。

title: Convexity of Inverse Blocking Curves in Loss Systems
affiliations: SKEMA Business School

detail.title: Convexity of Inverse Blocking Curves in Loss Systems
detail.abstract: We study the inverse of the Erlang loss (Erlang-B) formula, namely the maximum offered load supportable at a fixed blocking target as a function of the number of servers. We show that this inverse blocking curve is strictly increasing and globally convex, yielding an exact economies-of-scale statement for loss-system dimensioning. The proof is based on a tilted-measure representation and extends to the finite-waiting-room multi-server model.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了Erlang损失公式的逆函数，证明了在固定阻塞目标下，可支持的最大负载随服务器数量严格递增且全局凸，为损失系统规模经济提供了精确表述。
AI.research_question: 在固定阻塞目标下，Erlang损失公式的逆函数（即最大可支持负载作为服务器数量的函数）具有怎样的数学性质？
AI.motivation: 理解损失系统规模经济特性，为电信网络、呼叫中心等排队系统的容量规划提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 排队理论、Erlang损失公式（Erlang-B公式）、凸分析、倾斜测度表示法
AI.method: 基于倾斜测度表示的数学证明方法，扩展应用到有限等待室多服务器模型
AI.findings: 逆阻塞曲线严格递增且全局凸，这意味着损失系统存在精确的规模经济效应
AI.theory_contributions: 首次证明了Erlang-B公式逆函数的严格递增性和全局凸性，为排队理论提供了新的数学结果
AI.practical_contributions: 为电信网络、呼叫中心等系统的容量规划提供了精确的规模经济分析工具，帮助优化资源配置决策

title: Why Governments Keep Missing Technology Crises Before They Happen: From WannaCry to AI
affiliations: University of Liverpool

detail.title: Why Governments Keep Missing Technology Crises Before They Happen: From WannaCry to AI
detail.abstract: Parliamentary inquiries following the WannaCry ransomware attack revealed a disturbing pattern: government institutions had complied with security standards yet remained catastrophically vulnerable. The problem lies not in implementation failures but in the structure of democratic oversight. Technology oversight operates on annual planning cycles while threats evolve monthly, creating systematic blind spots that turn compliance into false confidence. Rather than reflecting individual or organisational shortcomings, this pattern arises from governance architectures calibrated for slower technological eras. As the UK builds regulatory frameworks for artificial intelligence, it risks embedding these structural failures into systems where consequences will be far more severe. This article proposes three institutional reforms, grounded in parliamentary evidence and comparative governance analysis: continuous reassessment with flow-constrained prioritisation, a real-time intelligence infrastructure as a public good, and regulatory frameworks designed to trigger their own revision. These mechanisms address governance temporality as the core failure mode in technology oversight.

AI.tldr: 英国议会调查显示，政府机构虽符合安全标准但仍遭WannaCry勒索软件攻击，问题根源在于民主监督结构与技术威胁演变速度不匹配，导致合规变成虚假信心。文章提出三项制度性改革方案。
AI.research_question: 为什么政府机构在符合安全标准的情况下仍然容易遭受网络攻击？如何改革技术监督的治理架构以应对快速演变的技术威胁？
AI.motivation: WannaCry勒索软件攻击后议会调查揭示的悖论：机构合规但依然脆弱，暴露了民主监督体系与技术进步速度之间的结构性不匹配问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理时间性理论、制度设计理论、比较治理分析、公共物品理论
AI.method: 基于议会证据的分析和比较治理分析
AI.findings: 技术监督采用年度规划周期，而威胁每月都在演变，这种时间不匹配导致系统性盲点，使合规变成虚假信心。问题根源在于为较慢技术时代设计的治理架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"治理时间性"作为技术监督的核心失效模式，将合规失败重新定义为结构性问题而非实施问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项具体改革：1) 基于流量约束优先级的持续重新评估；2) 作为公共物品的实时情报基础设施；3) 设计能够触发自身修订的监管框架。

title: Demand-Driven Contractual Closed-Loop Theory : A Framework for Resource Allocation Based on Real Usage Feedback

detail.title: Demand-Driven Contractual Closed-Loop Theory : A Framework for Resource Allocation Based on Real Usage Feedback
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a new institutional and resource allocation framework, termed Demand-Driven Contractual Closed-Loop Theory (DDCCLT). The theory addresses the structural limitations of traditional allocation mechanisms-such as price signals, administrative planning, and prediction-based models-under conditions of high automation, digitalization, and platform-based coordination. Rather than relying on ex ante forecasts, statistical demand estimation, or centralized decision-making, DDCCLT emphasizes "real usage behavior" as a continuous feedback signal for contract execution, resource reallocation, and institutional adjustment. By structuring resource allocation as a recursive closed loop-Demand → Contract → Execution → Feedback → Re-contracting-the framework illustrates how dynamic coordination can emerge without centralized prediction. By internalizing usage feedback as a generative institutional mechanism, DDCCLT offers a pathway to minimize allocative inefficiencies caused by speculative pricing and rigid planning models. The contribution of this paper is conceptual and structural. It introduces a general theoretical framework intended to serve as a foundation for future formal modeling, empirical simulation, and applied research in algorithmic governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了需求驱动契约闭环理论（DDCCLT），这是一种新的制度和资源分配框架，通过将实际使用行为作为连续反馈信号，构建需求→契约→执行→反馈→重新契约的递归闭环，解决传统分配机制在高自动化、数字化和平台协调条件下的结构局限性。
AI.research_question: 在高自动化、数字化和平台协调条件下，如何设计一个能够克服传统分配机制（价格信号、行政规划、预测模型）结构局限性的新型制度和资源分配框架？
AI.motivation: 传统分配机制（价格信号、行政规划、预测模型）在高自动化、数字化和平台协调条件下存在结构局限性，导致分配效率低下，需要新的理论框架来解决这些问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求驱动契约闭环理论（DDCCLT），强调"实际使用行为"作为契约执行、资源重新分配和制度调整的连续反馈信号，构建递归闭环分配机制。
AI.method: 概念性和结构性分析，提出理论框架，为未来的正式建模、实证模拟和算法治理应用研究奠定基础。
AI.findings: DDCCLT框架通过将使用反馈内化为生成性制度机制，提供了一条最小化由投机定价和刚性规划模型引起的分配效率低下的路径，展示了无需集中预测的动态协调如何出现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个通用的理论框架，为算法治理领域的未来正式建模、实证模拟和应用研究奠定概念基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计更有效的资源分配系统提供了结构性指导，特别是在高自动化、数字化和平台协调环境中，有助于减少分配效率低下问题。

title: Passive Investing in a Fast AI Economy
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Passive Investing in a Fast AI Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patients, or case studies requiring ethics approval. All data used are publicly available.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently, without external funding or institutional support.

detail.abstract: AI is compressing competitive time by reducing the cost of execution across design, development, coordination, and deployment. As a result, many downstream advantages become less durable, leadership turns over more quickly, and discretionary stock picking becomes harder. The same dynamic creates a design problem for passive investors: low-cost index implementation relies on rules that constrain turnover and trading frictions, even as categories and winners can change faster. This paper offers a practitioner framework in three steps. First, it argues that scarcity persists and relocates upstream into bottlenecks that are difficult to scale quickly, including compute supply chains, grid capacity and interconnection, and trusted data and institutions. Second, it treats passive as a design space and identifies index methodology levers that improve representational responsiveness subject to a turnover budget. Third, it proposes a rotation-survival portfolio that combines a broad-market anchor, diversified bottleneck sleeves with broad inclusion, and modest rules-based guardrails to remain invested through scarcity rotation rather than time it.

AI.tldr: AI压缩竞争时间，降低执行成本，使下游优势难以持久，领导地位更替加速，主动选股变难。这给被动投资者带来设计问题：低成本指数投资依赖限制换手率的规则，而行业和赢家变化更快。本文提出三步实践框架：1)稀缺性向上游转移至难以快速扩展的瓶颈（算力供应链、电网容量、可信数据等）；2)将被动投资视为设计空间，在换手率预算内改进指数代表性响应；3)提出"轮动-生存"组合，结合宽基锚定、多元化瓶颈板块和适度规则护栏，通过稀缺性轮动而非择时保持投资。
AI.research_question: 在AI加速竞争、压缩优势持续时间的背景下，被动投资者如何设计指数策略来应对快速变化的行业格局和赢家轮换？
AI.motivation: AI降低了设计、开发、协调和部署的执行成本，压缩了竞争时间，使得下游优势变得不持久，领导地位更替加速，主动选股变得困难。这对被动投资者构成设计挑战：低成本指数投资依赖限制换手率的规则，而行业分类和赢家变化更快。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 稀缺性理论：稀缺性向上游转移至难以快速扩展的瓶颈领域；2) 指数设计理论：将被动投资视为设计空间，平衡代表性响应和换手率约束；3) 组合构建理论：轮动-生存组合框架，结合宽基锚定、多元化瓶颈暴露和规则护栏。
AI.method: 提出三步实践框架：1) 分析稀缺性向上游转移的瓶颈（算力供应链、电网容量与互联、可信数据与机构）；2) 将被动投资视为设计空间，识别改进指数代表性响应的方法论杠杆；3) 设计轮动-生存组合的具体构建方法。
AI.findings: 1) 稀缺性从下游优势向上游瓶颈转移，这些瓶颈难以快速扩展；2) 指数设计可以在换手率预算内提高对市场变化的响应能力；3) 轮动-生存组合能够通过宽基锚定、多元化瓶颈暴露和适度规则护栏，实现通过稀缺性轮动保持投资而非择时。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展了稀缺性理论在AI时代的应用，提出稀缺性向上游瓶颈转移的框架；2) 发展了被动投资设计理论，将指数方法论视为可优化的设计空间；3) 提出了轮动-生存组合构建的新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为投资者识别AI时代的稀缺性瓶颈提供实践指南；2) 为指数设计者提供改进指数响应性的方法论杠杆；3) 为投资组合经理提供具体的轮动-生存组合构建方案，帮助在快速变化的市场中保持投资。

title: A Predictive Framework for Dynamic Stakeholder Management in Volatile Environments

detail.title: A Predictive Framework for Dynamic Stakeholder Management in Volatile Environments
detail.abstract: Contemporary organisational environments are characterised by rapid and non-linear shifts in stakeholder alignment driven by geopolitical change, regulatory evolution, technological disruption, and value reconfiguration. This paper introduces the Predictive Stakeholder Positioning Model, a framework that extends classical stakeholder theory by incorporating stakeholder propensity as a predictive dimension alongside conventional measures of power, interest, and engagement. Drawing on dynamic stakeholder literature, behavioural stakeholder research, and longitudinal organisational observation, the model conceptualises propensity as a latent dispositional inclination that is temporally prior to observable engagement. By identifying shifts in propensity before they materialise into overt support or opposition, leaders gain strategic opportunities for anticipatory relationship management. The framework has been operationalised in a digital stakeholder-management platform enabling temporal tracking, network visualisation and scenario planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了预测性利益相关者定位模型，将倾向性作为预测维度纳入传统利益相关者分析，帮助管理者在利益相关者态度显化前进行预测性关系管理。
AI.research_question: 如何预测利益相关者态度和行为的变化，以便在组织环境中进行更有效的战略关系管理？
AI.motivation: 当代组织环境面临地缘政治变化、监管演变、技术颠覆和价值重构等快速非线性变化，传统利益相关者分析难以预测这些动态变化，需要新的预测性框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展经典利益相关者理论，结合动态利益相关者文献、行为利益相关者研究和纵向组织观察，引入倾向性作为预测维度。
AI.method: 开发预测性利益相关者定位模型，并将其操作化为数字利益相关者管理平台，支持时间追踪、网络可视化和情景规划。
AI.findings: 倾向性作为潜在的倾向性倾向，在可观察的参与之前存在时间上的优先性，通过识别倾向性变化可以在利益相关者支持或反对显化前获得战略机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了经典利益相关者理论，增加了预测维度；将倾向性概念化为时间上优先于可观察参与的潜在倾向；整合了动态和行为视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了预测性关系管理的战略工具；开发了数字平台支持实时追踪和情景规划；帮助领导者在利益相关者态度显化前采取行动。

title: Comprehensive Analysis of Shared E-Scooter Micromobility Services in Turin, Italy
affiliations: Politecnico di Torino

detail.title: Comprehensive Analysis of Shared E-Scooter Micromobility Services in Turin, Italy
detail.abstract: This report presents an empirical analysis of shared electric scooter (e-scooter) operations in Turin, Italy. We examine 2,548,650 validated trips from three licensed operators (LIME, VOI, and BIRD) spanning a 23-month observation period (January 2024 to November 2025). The analysis addresses five key research questions: (1) data quality and temporal mobility patterns, (2) origin-destination flow structures using Turin's official statistical zones, (3) competition versus complementarity with public transport, (4) parking duration patterns and ghost vehicle identification, and (5) economic feasibility through profit-and-loss analysis. Our findings reveal that e-scooters function primarily as first-mile/last-mile connectors, with a 95.1% feeder rate at the 200-meter buffer threshold, rather than direct competitors to public transport. Parking analysis identified only 0.15% ghost vehicles (parked more than 120 hours), indicating efficient fleet utilization. The combined market generates €8.30 million annually with a 57.7% profit margin, indicating strong financial sustainability without need for municipal subsidies.

AI.tldr: 本研究对意大利都灵的共享电动滑板车运营进行实证分析，基于三家运营商254万次行程数据，发现电动滑板车主要作为公共交通的"第一/最后一公里"连接器而非直接竞争者，市场年收入830万欧元且利润率57.7%，具有财务可持续性。
AI.research_question: 1. 数据质量和时间移动模式；2. 基于官方统计区的起讫点流结构；3. 与公共交通的竞争与互补关系；4. 停放时长模式和幽灵车辆识别；5. 通过损益分析评估经济可行性。
AI.motivation: 随着共享电动滑板车在全球城市快速普及，需要实证研究其在城市交通系统中的实际作用、运营效率和经济可持续性，为城市交通规划和政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市交通系统理论、多模式交通整合理论、共享经济运营效率理论、公共交通补充理论、第一/最后一公里连接理论。
AI.method: 基于三家运营商（LIME、VOI、BIRD）2,548,650次验证行程的实证分析，时间跨度为23个月（2024年1月至2025年11月），采用统计分析、空间分析、经济分析等方法。
AI.findings: 1. 电动滑板车主要作为公共交通的"第一/最后一公里"连接器（200米缓冲区内95.1%的接驳率）；2. 幽灵车辆仅占0.15%（停放超过120小时）；3. 市场年收入830万欧元，利润率57.7%，无需市政补贴；4. 与公共交通是互补而非竞争关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了共享电动滑板车作为公共交通补充的理论；2. 提供了第一/最后一公里连接效率的量化证据；3. 发展了共享交通系统运营效率评估框架；4. 丰富了多模式交通整合理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为城市交通规划者提供电动滑板车整合策略；2. 为运营商提供高效的运营管理参考；3. 为政策制定者提供无需补贴的经济可行性证据；4. 为城市交通可持续发展提供实证支持。

title: A Taxonomy of AI Governance Approaches: Distinguishing Visibility, Alignment, and Authorization

detail.title: A Taxonomy of AI Governance Approaches: Distinguishing Visibility, Alignment, and Authorization

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of FERZ, Inc., a company developing AI governance technologies. The concepts and definitions presented in this paper were developed independently as a theoretical and technical taxonomy and are published for general scholarly and evaluative use. No external organization influenced the analysis or conclusions presented.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental subjects. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract:
The term AI governance is increasingly applied to a wide range of practices, including logging, monitoring, model alignment, guardrails, and policy documentation. This conceptual overloading obscures a critical distinction: many widely deployed “governance” mechanisms provide visibility into system behavior or influence model outputs, but do not establish whether a specific AI-mediated action was authorized under binding policy constraints at the time of execution.

This paper proposes a taxonomy that separates AI governance into three fundamentally different problem domains: operational visibility, behavioral alignment, and decision authorization. It argues that authorization constitutes a distinct governance function that cannot be satisfied by post-hoc audit logs, probabilistic alignment techniques, or policy workflows alone. The paper introduces a formal, falsifiable definition of deterministic AI governance, defined as a pre-execution authorization layer in which identical governed state produces identical governance verdicts and where systems emit replayable, verifier-grade decision artifacts sufficient for independent third-party verification.

The taxonomy specifies the minimum requirements for such governance, including a normative definition of governed state, a minimum evidence package, an enforcement triad (ALLOW / DENY / ABSTAIN) with fail-closed semantics, and a set of adversarial “anti-laundering” tests designed to distinguish genuine governance from trust-based or vendor-dependent imitations. The paper is intended to provide enterprise buyers, regulators, auditors, and researchers with a shared vocabulary and concrete evaluation criteria for assessing AI governance claims in high-stakes, regulated environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI治理的三领域分类法：操作可见性、行为对齐和决策授权，强调授权是独立治理功能，需要确定性AI治理框架
AI.research_question: 如何区分AI治理的不同功能领域，特别是如何建立可验证的决策授权机制？
AI.motivation: 当前"AI治理"概念被过度泛化，混淆了不同治理机制的本质区别，导致高风险监管环境中缺乏可验证的授权机制
AI.theoretical_framework: AI治理三领域分类法：操作可见性、行为对齐、决策授权；确定性AI治理理论框架
AI.method: 概念分析、分类法构建、形式化定义、对抗性测试设计
AI.findings: 授权是独立治理功能，需要确定性AI治理框架，包括治理状态定义、证据包、执行三元组和反洗钱测试
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI治理三领域分类法，形式化定义确定性AI治理，建立可验证授权理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业买家、监管机构、审计师和研究人员提供评估AI治理主张的共同词汇和具体标准

title: Legal Order in the Age of AI Agents
affiliations: Victoria University of Wellington  and University of Toronto - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Legal Order in the Age of AI Agents

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Toronto Law Journal (forthcoming, 2026)

detail.abstract: As AI tools increasingly shape everyday life, autonomous AI agents are emerging as a new frontier. This Article demonstrates how AI legal agents, empowered to act independently on behalf of human users, could structurally reconfigure legal systems through three transformative pathways. First, AI legal agents promise to democratize legal knowledge by dismantling vertical and horizontal institutional barriers to justice. Second, these agents could reconstitute legal authority through algorithmic constitutionalism, accelerated jurisdictional synthesis, and legal pluralism, enabling novel frameworks of AI-mediated dispute resolution that challenge traditional paradigms of jurisdiction and legitimacy. Third, such agents may shift the temporal focus of legal intervention from post-violation remediation to continuous preventive measures. Harnessing this triple transformation-the democratization, pluralistic reconstitution, and temporal shift-will require design frameworks that balance accountability with efficiency, fairness with personalization, and societal values with algorithmic optimization. Together, these developments gesture toward a legal singularity, a future in which AI legal agents, through their continuous interaction with human judgment and institutional frameworks, render law increasingly self-organizing, adaptive, and intelligible.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI法律代理如何通过三条路径重构法律体系：民主化法律知识、重构法律权威、以及从事后救济转向持续预防，最终指向法律奇点的未来。
AI.research_question: AI法律代理如何通过民主化、权威重构和时间性转变三条路径结构性重构法律体系？
AI.motivation: 随着AI工具日益影响日常生活，自主AI代理成为新前沿，AI法律代理能够独立代表用户行动，可能对法律体系产生结构性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法宪政主义、加速司法融合、法律多元主义、AI调解争议解决框架、法律奇点理论。
AI.method: 概念分析框架，通过理论推演识别三条转型路径：民主化、权威重构、时间性转变。
AI.findings: AI法律代理通过三条路径重构法律体系：1) 打破垂直和水平制度障碍，民主化法律知识；2) 通过算法宪政、司法融合和多元主义重构法律权威；3) 从事后救济转向持续预防措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI法律代理三重转型理论框架，发展了算法宪政主义、法律多元主义在AI时代的应用，推进了法律奇点的理论概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI法律代理设计提供平衡问责与效率、公平与个性化、社会价值与算法优化的框架，指导未来AI法律系统开发。

title: Market Return Decomposition and Equity Risk Premium Predictability
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Antai College of Economics and Management, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Aetna School of Management, Washington University in St. Louis - John M. Olin Business School and

detail.title: Market Return Decomposition and Equity Risk Premium Predictability
detail.abstract: We introduce a novel decomposition of stock market returns into a fundamental component (FC), capturing long-term growth, and an unexpected capital gain component (UC), reflecting short-term fluctuations. The decomposition is explicit, straightforward to estimate, and designed to correct model misspecification in traditional predictive regressions. The FC aligns with highly persistent valuation ratios, while the UC is predictable via standard regressions, further improved by shrinkage. Using 41 predictors from Goyal et al. (2024), we find 33 significant predictors of market returns, compared with only 5 in their study. We argue that predictors jointly contain valuable information about stock returns, with combination forecasts showing significant out-of-sample predictive power, reaffirming the predictability of the equity risk premium documented in prior research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的股票市场收益分解方法，将其分为反映长期增长的基本成分（FC）和反映短期波动的意外资本利得成分（UC）。这种分解方法明确、易于估计，旨在纠正传统预测回归中的模型设定错误。研究发现，使用41个预测因子，有33个对市场收益有显著预测能力，远高于先前研究中仅有的5个。
AI.research_question: 如何通过新的收益分解方法来提高股票市场收益的预测能力？
AI.motivation: 传统预测回归存在模型设定错误问题，导致许多预测因子在统计上不显著。本文旨在通过创新的收益分解方法来纠正这一问题，更好地识别预测因子的信息价值。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 股票市场收益分解理论：将收益分解为基本成分（FC）和意外资本利得成分（UC）
2. 预测回归理论：传统预测回归模型及其局限性
3. 收缩估计方法：提高预测稳定性的统计技术
AI.method:
1. 提出明确的收益分解框架
2. 使用Goyal等人（2024）的41个预测因子
3. 采用标准回归和收缩改进方法
4. 进行样本内和样本外预测能力检验
AI.findings:
1. FC与高度持久的估值比率一致，UC可通过标准回归预测
2. 使用41个预测因子时，有33个对市场收益有显著预测能力，而先前研究仅发现5个
3. 预测因子联合包含关于股票收益的有价值信息
4. 组合预测显示出显著的样本外预测能力，证实了股权风险溢价的预测性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了新的股票市场收益分解理论框架
2. 纠正了传统预测回归中的模型设定错误
3. 为理解预测因子的信息价值提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提供了一种简单易行的收益分解和预测方法
2. 显著提高了市场收益的预测准确性
3. 为投资者和资产管理人提供了更有效的市场时机选择工具
4. 证实了股权风险溢价的预测性，对资产配置决策有重要参考价值

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨跨国公司在全球价值链中如何通过供应链管理实践影响现代奴役问题，分析企业社会责任与供应链透明度之间的关系。

title: Making Employers: The Effects of Supporting First Hires in a Large-Scale Randomized Experiment
affiliations: VATT Institute for Economic Research and Government of the Republic of Finland - VATT Institute for Economic Research

detail.title: Making Employers: The Effects of Supporting First Hires in a Large-Scale Randomized Experiment
detail.abstract: Most entrepreneurs operate without employees. Hiring may be unprofitable for them, but they may also be reluctant to pay the one-time costs of becoming an employer due to attentional costs, risk aversion, or credit constraints. We examine the extent to which a temporary subsidy to hire first employees induces entrepreneurs to become employers in a large-scale randomized experiment. The experiment offered to 34,500 randomly selected non-employer entrepreneurs e 10,000 to cover 50% of the wage costs of first employees. We find a 20% increase in the fraction of firms that hire workers, with effects of similar magnitude on wage costs and number of employees. The effects stay positive at 7% after the subsidy period, indicating that the temporary subsidy created new permanent employers. Our results suggest that frictions in hiring first employees can be an important barrier for employer entry and firm growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过大规模随机实验发现，为无雇员企业家提供临时雇佣补贴能显著增加他们成为雇主的机会，效果在补贴结束后仍持续存在，表明雇佣摩擦是阻碍企业成长的重要障碍。
AI.research_question: 临时雇佣补贴能在多大程度上诱导无雇员企业家成为雇主？这种效果在补贴结束后是否持续？
AI.motivation: 大多数企业家在没有雇员的情况下运营，这可能是因为雇佣不盈利，也可能是因为注意力成本、风险规避或信贷约束等一次性成本阻碍了他们成为雇主。理解这些摩擦对雇主进入和企业成长的影响具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于雇佣摩擦理论，包括注意力成本、风险规避和信贷约束等一次性成本阻碍企业家成为雇主。临时补贴可能通过降低这些摩擦来促进雇主进入。
AI.method: 大规模随机对照实验：向34,500名随机选择的无雇员企业家提供10,000欧元补贴，覆盖50%的首批雇员工资成本。通过比较处理组和对照组来评估补贴效果。
AI.findings: 1. 补贴使雇佣工人的企业比例增加20%；2. 对工资成本和雇员数量的影响幅度相似；3. 补贴期结束后效果仍保持7%的正向影响，表明临时补贴创造了新的永久雇主。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了雇佣摩擦阻碍雇主进入和企业成长的实证证据，验证了注意力成本、风险规避和信贷约束等理论机制的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了有效的干预工具：临时雇佣补贴能有效促进企业成长；2. 表明一次性成本是阻碍企业雇佣的关键因素；3. 提供了设计企业支持政策的实证依据。

title: Autonomous Weapon Systems and AI-Enabled Decision Support Systems in Military Targeting: A Comparison and Recommended Policy Responses
affiliations: Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI) and Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI)

detail.title: Autonomous Weapon Systems and AI-Enabled Decision Support Systems in Military Targeting: A Comparison and Recommended Policy Responses
detail.abstract: This report provides a comparative analysis of autonomous weapon systems (AWS) and artificial intelligence-enabled decision support systems (AI-DSS) used in in military targeting. It examines how both technologies shape human roles in decision making about the use of force, assesses their respective risks of unintended harm and analyses the key issues they raise under international law. By mapping the key similarities and differences between AWS and AI-DSS—particularly in their deployment across different phases of the targeting cycle—the report clarifies where existing policy frameworks apply and where gaps remain. It outlines three options for policymakers with regards to AI-DSS: integrate AI-DSS into current AWS processes, establish a dedicated track for AI-DSS or pursue no targeted response. The report concludes with three actionable recommendations aimed at supporting responsible governance: explore the need for a separate multilateral process for AI-DSS, build on lessons from AWS governance and prioritize research to guide the responsible integration of AI into military decision making.

AI.tldr: 该报告比较分析了军事目标识别中的自主武器系统（AWS）和人工智能决策支持系统（AI-DSS），探讨它们如何影响人类在武力使用决策中的角色，评估各自的无意伤害风险，并分析国际法下的关键问题。
AI.research_question: AWS和AI-DSS在军事目标识别中如何影响人类决策角色？它们各自的风险和在国际法下的问题是什么？现有政策框架的适用性和差距在哪里？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在军事领域的应用日益广泛，需要明确AWS和AI-DSS的区别与联系，为政策制定提供依据，确保负责任地整合AI到军事决策中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际法框架、军事目标识别周期理论、人机交互决策理论、风险管理理论
AI.method: 比较分析法，通过映射AWS和AI-DSS在目标识别周期不同阶段的相似性和差异性进行分析
AI.findings: 明确了AWS和AI-DSS在影响人类决策角色、风险特征和国际法问题方面的异同；识别了现有政策框架的适用性和差距；提出了三种政策选项
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了AWS和AI-DSS的比较分析框架，澄清了两者在军事决策中的不同作用机制，为国际法适用性提供了理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了三种具体选项；提出了三项可操作建议：探索独立的AI-DSS多边进程、借鉴AWS治理经验、优先研究负责任整合AI到军事决策

title: Comparing Health Estimates in the PSID and NHIS, 2001-2015
affiliations: University of Michigan at Ann Arbor and University of Michigan at Ann Arbor

detail.title: Comparing Health Estimates in the PSID and NHIS, 2001-2015

declarations.funderStatement: Funding for this research was provided by the National Institute on Aging (R01-AG040213).

publicationDetails.detailsText: Panel Study of Income Dynamics Technical Paper No. 17-01
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Michigan Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) Technical Paper Series

detail.abstract: The Panel Study of Income Dynamics is a unique resource for studying the influence of early and adult life circumstances on health and mortality in later life (McGonagle et al. 2012). Since the late 1990s, the study has included questions about health status, health conditions, health behaviors, health insurance, and health care expenditures. Retrospective questions about childhood health have been asked since 2007. The objective of this brief report is to provide a comparison over 15 years between the health status and health condition data that have been collected in the PSID with estimates from the most widely used nationally representative health survey, the National Health Interview Survey (NHIS). We begin by briefly summarizing the health information that has been collected throughout the history of the PSID. The subsequent section describes the health measures to be compared between the two surveys. The estimates for each survey are then presented. In general, despite differences in the designs of the two surveys, the health-related measures align well over time.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了收入动态面板研究（PSID）与全国健康访谈调查（NHIS）在15年间收集的健康状况数据，发现尽管两项调查设计不同，但健康相关指标随时间变化趋势一致。
AI.research_question: PSID与NHIS这两项全国代表性健康调查在15年间收集的健康状况数据是否具有可比性？
AI.motivation: PSID作为研究早期和成年生活状况对晚年健康和死亡率影响的独特资源，需要验证其健康数据的可靠性和与其他全国代表性调查的一致性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于调查数据质量评估理论，关注不同调查设计下数据可比性的验证框架。
AI.method: 描述性比较分析：回顾PSID健康数据收集历史，识别可比健康指标，对比PSID与NHIS在15年间的健康状态和健康状况数据。
AI.findings: 尽管PSID和NHIS在调查设计上存在差异，但两者收集的健康相关指标随时间变化趋势高度一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了PSID健康数据的可靠性，为使用PSID进行生命历程健康研究提供了方法学支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员提供了PSID与NHIS健康数据的可比性证据，增强了使用PSID数据进行健康相关研究的信心。

title: Towards a Theory of Modular Natives
affiliations: University of Oxford - Said Business School, IT University of Copenhagen and University of Oxford

detail.title: Towards a Theory of Modular Natives
detail.abstract: First, we present a new theory, the "theory of modular natives." A modular native is a basic building block that was born modular, e.g., a solar or a battery cell. The theory predicts that using modular natives in building things reduces complexity and risk and improves predictability, resulting in better outcomes and faster scale-up. Second, we test the theory on the largest dataset of its kind. We find, at a high level of statistical significance (p < 0.001), that modular natives operate under a fundamentally different risk regime than other project types, with finite and predictable risk, in contrast to non-natives that have infinite and unpredictable risk. The findings help explain why modularity is key to successful building while bespokeness often leads to failure. Third, we relate our findings to economic and geopolitical development, arguing that China understands modular natives and scale-up better than any other geography and that this is key to China's swiftly growing dominance in renewables, batteries, EVs, robots, etc. We argue that China's mastery of modularity and scale-up is a major innovation in its own right, among the greatest and most impactful in human history, falsifying the common notion that China cannot innovate. Business and government outside China ignore these findings at their peril. Finally, we spell out policy and practice implications and identify areas for further research.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"模块化原生"理论，认为使用模块化原生组件（如太阳能电池、电池单元）可以降低复杂性、减少风险、提高可预测性，从而获得更好结果和更快规模化。实证研究发现模块化原生项目具有有限且可预测的风险，而非模块化项目则面临无限且不可预测的风险。研究还指出中国在理解和应用模块化原生及规模化方面领先全球，这是中国在可再生能源、电池、电动汽车等领域快速崛起的关键。
AI.research_question: 模块化原生组件如何影响项目风险、复杂性和规模化能力？中国在模块化原生应用方面的优势如何解释其在多个技术领域的快速崛起？
AI.motivation: 解释为什么模块化是成功建设的关键，而定制化往往导致失败；理解中国在可再生能源、电池、电动汽车等领域快速崛起的根本原因；挑战"中国不能创新"的普遍观念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模块化原生理论：模块化原生是指天生模块化的基本构建块（如太阳能电池、电池单元）。该理论预测使用模块化原生可以降低复杂性、减少风险、提高可预测性，从而带来更好结果和更快规模化。
AI.method: 实证研究：使用同类中最大的数据集对理论进行检验，采用高统计显著性水平（p < 0.001）进行分析。
AI.findings: 模块化原生项目与非模块化项目在风险机制上存在根本差异：模块化原生项目具有有限且可预测的风险，而非模块化项目则面临无限且不可预测的风险。这解释了为什么模块化是成功建设的关键，而定制化往往导致失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"模块化原生"这一新理论框架；建立了模块化与风险可预测性之间的理论联系；挑战了传统创新观念，认为模块化和规模化本身就是重大创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国在可再生能源、电池、电动汽车等领域的成功提供了理论解释；为企业和政府提供了关于模块化战略重要性的实践启示；指出了中国在模块化规模化方面的创新优势；提出了政策建议和未来研究方向。

title: The Deliberate Amputation of Descartes’ Theory: The Explosion of U.S. Public Debt Is Not a Policy Failure but a First-Physics Illusion That Responsibility Can Be Annihilated

detail.title: The Deliberate Amputation of Descartes’ Theory: The Explosion of U.S. Public Debt Is Not a Policy Failure but a First-Physics Illusion That Responsibility Can Be Annihilated

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work is a conceptual and theoretical study and does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects. Therefore, ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Over the past four decades, U.S. public debt has risen roughly twenty-one-fold, while nominal GDP has grown only about sevenfold. This widening "alligator mouth" is not merely a policy failure but a symptom of a deeper conceptual error. For centuries, the dominant scientific paradigm-what I call First Physics-has modelled the world in terms of matter, energy, and information, while treating responsibility and meaning as external to its formal language. Enabled by a selective, post-Cartesian amputation of God from Descartes' original system, this First Physics operating system has encouraged the illusion that responsibility can be diluted, exported, or made to disappear. In response, I propose Second Physics: a relational framework that treats responsibility as a conserved quantity in its own right. The Law of Conservation of Responsibility states that responsibility cannot be destroyed; it can only be transferred across agents, places, and generations. Using long-run data on U.S. federal debt and GDP, I show that the current trajectory embodies a structurally unsustainable configuration: an overextended, debt-financed, desire-driven capitalism-what I describe as a second Tower of Babel-quietly supported by the West as a whole, Japan included. Second Physics does not condemn the American dream, the dollar, capitalism, or growth as such. Rather, it makes mathematically explicit why the particular First Physics operating system under which they have been combined has reached its structural limit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"第二物理学"框架，将责任视为守恒量，解释美国公债与GDP增长脱节的结构性不可持续问题。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国公债增长远超GDP增长？这种"鳄鱼嘴"现象背后的深层概念错误是什么？
AI.motivation: 过去40年美国公债增长21倍而名义GDP仅增长7倍，这种结构性失衡不仅是政策失败，更是深层概念错误的症状。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第一物理学（传统科学范式）vs 第二物理学（关系框架）；责任守恒定律；责任作为守恒量；欲望驱动资本主义；第二巴别塔隐喻。
AI.method: 使用美国联邦债务和GDP的长期数据进行分析，展示结构性不可持续的配置。
AI.findings: 当前轨迹体现结构性不可持续配置：过度扩张、债务融资、欲望驱动的资本主义，得到西方（包括日本）的隐性支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出第二物理学框架和"责任守恒定律"；将责任视为守恒量；揭示第一物理学操作系统的结构极限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解债务与增长脱节提供新框架；指出当前经济模式的结构性不可持续性；为政策制定提供概念基础。

title: How Public Officials Decide: Experimental Evidence on Deliberation in the Public Sector
affiliations: , London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) and University of Bristol

detail.title: How Public Officials Decide: Experimental Evidence on Deliberation in the Public Sector
detail.abstract: How can governments encourage public officials to make decisions in the public interest, when officials differ in their motivations? We address this question using an experiment with currently serving middle management public officials in the context of weak institutional capacity. The experiment compares decisions made under personal framing with decisions made under an identical professional (policy) framing, allowing us to test whether officials apply the same care and judgement when deciding on behalf of the public as they do when deciding for themselves. We find that, on average, officials make decisions differently across the two frames, and that this divergence is driven by officials with lower public service motivation. We then introduce a simple, low-cost institutional intervention by randomly assigning officials to make joint decisions with a peer. Relative to officials who repeat the task individually, deliberation shifts decisions in mixed-motivation teams toward the choices of more motivated officials. Together, our results highlight how organizational features such as peer deliberation can complement selection and incentives in shaping public sector decision-making.

AI.tldr: 研究通过实验发现，在制度能力薄弱的环境中，公共官员在个人决策和职业决策框架下会做出不同选择，这种差异主要由公共服务动机较低的官员驱动。引入简单的同伴审议机制后，混合动机团队会向动机更强的官员的决策方向转变。
AI.research_question: 政府如何激励公共官员做出符合公共利益的决策，特别是在官员动机各异的情况下？
AI.motivation: 在制度能力薄弱的环境中，理解官员决策行为对于改善公共部门治理至关重要。需要探究官员在个人和职业角色下的决策差异，以及如何通过低成本干预来改善决策质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共服务动机理论、行为公共管理理论、组织决策理论、制度设计理论
AI.method: 实验方法：对现任中层公共官员进行随机对照实验。比较个人框架与职业（政策）框架下的决策差异，并引入同伴审议干预，观察团队决策的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 官员在个人框架和职业框架下平均做出不同决策；2. 这种差异主要由公共服务动机较低的官员驱动；3. 引入同伴审议后，混合动机团队的决策会向动机更强的官员的选择方向转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了公共服务动机理论在决策框架效应中的应用；2. 揭示了动机异质性对公共决策的影响机制；3. 为组织特征如何补充选拔和激励机制提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政府提供了低成本的组织干预方案（同伴审议）；2. 强调了在制度能力薄弱环境中改善决策的可行途径；3. 为公共部门人力资源管理提供了实证依据。

title: Team Formation with Altruism
affiliations: Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin

detail.title: Team Formation with Altruism

publicationDetails.detailsText: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series No. 218
publicationDetails.journalName: TRR 266 Accounting for Transparency Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper explores the strategic formation of teams within organizations with moral hazard, focusing on the impact of agents' altruism on incentive structures. The study contrasts teams composed of agents with similar preferences with teams that integrate diverse preferences. The analysis demonstrates that, for N identical projects and 2N agents, the principal's optimal strategy is to form antiassortative teams: pairing the most and least altruistic agents, then repeating the process with the remaining agents and so forth. This research highlights the importance of aligning agent preferences with strategic team formation to optimize organizational costs.

AI.tldr: 在道德风险组织中，研究代理人利他主义对激励结构的影响，发现当项目相同且代理人数量为项目数两倍时，最优团队组建策略是反配对匹配：将最利他和最不利他的代理人配对，然后对剩余代理人重复此过程。
AI.research_question: 在存在道德风险的组织中，代理人的利他主义如何影响激励结构？当组建团队时，应该将偏好相似的代理人配对还是将偏好不同的代理人配对？
AI.motivation: 组织中的团队组建决策对激励结构和组织成本有重要影响。理解代理人利他主义等偏好特征如何与团队结构相互作用，可以帮助管理者优化团队配置，降低激励成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于道德风险理论、团队激励理论和代理人偏好异质性理论，特别是利他主义作为代理人偏好的重要维度。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，假设有N个相同项目和2N个代理人，比较相似偏好团队与异质偏好团队的激励效果，推导最优团队组建策略。
AI.findings: 最优团队组建策略是反配对匹配：将最利他的代理人与最不利他的代理人配对，然后对剩余代理人重复此过程。这种异质团队结构能更好地优化激励成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展了道德风险框架下的团队激励理论；2) 提出了代理人偏好异质性对团队组建的影响机制；3) 建立了反配对匹配的最优团队组建理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为管理者提供了具体的团队组建指导原则；2) 展示了如何通过战略性的团队配置降低激励成本；3) 强调了考虑代理人偏好特征在人力资源管理中的重要性。

title: Institutional Weakness during Democratic Transition and Its Role in the 1997 Economic Crisis in South Korea
affiliations: and Independent

detail.title: Institutional Weakness during Democratic Transition and Its Role in the 1997 Economic Crisis in South Korea
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the role of institutional failures in the establishment and aggravation of the 1997 economic crisis within the context of the post-1987 democratic transition of South Korea. This paper will propose that the 1997 economic crisis cannot only be explained by short-term macroeconomic failures but also that institutional failures played a significant part in it. Although political pluralism is increased during the time of democratic transition, the informal discipline system that operated during the authoritarian period lacked strength, but it failed to develop proper rule-of-law-based regulatory institutions, creating areas of supervisory weakness in the financial system, along with over-borrowing by the giant business groups and a buildup of systemic risk.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了制度失败在1997年韩国经济危机中的作用，认为危机不仅源于短期宏观经济失败，更与民主转型期间未能建立有效的法治监管制度有关。
AI.research_question: 制度失败在1997年韩国经济危机的形成和加剧中扮演了什么角色？
AI.motivation: 传统上对1997年经济危机的解释主要关注短期宏观经济因素，但本文认为需要从制度层面深入分析，特别是在韩国1987年后民主转型的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、民主转型理论、金融监管理论、系统性风险理论
AI.method: 历史制度分析、案例研究（韩国1997年经济危机）、文献分析
AI.findings: 1. 民主转型期间政治多元化增加，但威权时期的非正式纪律体系失效；2. 未能建立基于法治的监管制度，导致金融体系监管薄弱；3. 大型企业集团过度借贷和系统性风险积累。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将制度失败理论应用于新兴民主国家的经济危机分析；2. 揭示了民主转型与制度建设的非同步性；3. 提出了制度真空期的概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为新兴民主国家提供制度建设的重要启示；2. 强调了金融监管体系在民主转型中的关键作用；3. 为防范类似经济危机提供政策建议。
