Anti-tarnishment laws protect famous brands from uses that could damage their reputation, even when consumers are not confused about who makes the tarnishing product.

The Supreme Court recently declared some trademark registration restrictions unconstitutional in Matal v. Tam and Iancu v. Brunetti. In these cases, the Court struct down federal laws that prevented registration of "disparaging" and "scandalous or immoral" trademarks. The Court held the registration bars were unconstitutional viewpoint-based restrictions. Many legal scholars argue that following Tam and Brunetti, anti-tarnishment laws are also unconstitutional viewpoint-based restrictions because they allow trademark owners to silence criticism and negative commentary.

However, Elster provides new frameworks for evaluating anti-tarnishment laws. In Elster, an applicant was barred from registering a mark critical of Donald Trump and challenged the bar as an unconstitutional speech restriction. The Justices agreed that the provision, which barred registration of a mark that "consists of or comprises a name, portrait, or signature identifying a particular living individual except by his written consent," was a content-based but viewpoint-neutral restriction. But the Court did not apply strict scrutiny to the provision, even though content-based laws often trigger strict scrutiny. The majority instead utilized a more flexible approach, examining the historical tradition of similar trademark restrictions and their co-existence with the First Amendment. Four concurring Justices would instead have held the restriction reasonably serves trademark law's fundamental purposes of preventing consumer confusion and protecting mark-owner goodwill.

This article argues that anti-tarnishment protection should survive constitutional challenges under either approach. These laws target harm from incongruous associations - including using a luxury brand on inferior products - rather than suppressing particular viewpoints. They safeguard the commercial goodwill that trademark owners have developed through years of business investment, and that goodwill provides valuable sorting signals to consumers. This article further cautions against using constitutional scrutiny to dismantle reasonable commercial regulations, including trademark laws generally and the anti-tarnishment provision in particular.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在最高法院2024年Vidal v. Elster案判决后，探讨商标反玷污法是否应被视为合宪。文章认为反玷污法应通过宪法审查，因其保护商标商誉而非压制特定观点。
AI.research_question: 在最高法院2024年Vidal v. Elster案判决后，商标反玷污法是否应被视为合宪？
AI.motivation: 最高法院在Matal v. Tam和Iancu v. Brunetti案中宣布某些商标注册限制违宪，许多学者认为反玷污法也是违宪的观点限制。但Elster案为评估反玷污法提供了新框架，需要重新审视其合宪性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第一修正案言论自由理论、商标法理论（防止消费者混淆和保护商誉）、宪法审查标准（严格审查vs灵活方法）、历史传统分析框架。
AI.method: 法律分析、判例比较、历史传统考察、理论论证。通过分析最高法院相关判例（Tam、Brunetti、Elster），探讨反玷污法的合宪性基础。
AI.findings: 反玷污法应通过宪法挑战：1）针对的是不协调关联造成的损害而非压制观点；2）保护商标所有者通过商业投资建立的商誉；3）为消费者提供有价值的分类信号；4）Elster案提供了更灵活的审查方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）为商标反玷污法的合宪性提供新的理论框架；2）澄清反玷污法与观点限制的区别；3）提出商业法规应避免过度宪法审查的理论观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为商标所有者提供法律确定性；2）指导法院如何适用Elster案框架评估反玷污法；3）警示不应使用宪法审查来拆除合理的商业法规。

title: Adoption-Driven Authority Transfer (ADAT): A Structural Model of Control Loss in Sociotechnical Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Adoption-Driven Authority Transfer (ADAT): A Structural Model of Control Loss in Sociotechnical Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: No studies with patients/participants
declarations.funderStatement: Self Funded

detail.abstract: This paper introduces and formalizes the Adoption-Driven Authority Transfer (ADAT) model, a structural account of how human decision authority migrates to technical systems as a consequence of ordinary adoption dynamics. The model explains loss of effective human control without assuming intent, misalignment, or superintelligence. Extending diffusion-of-innovation, path-dependence, and infrastructure-entrenchment theories, ADAT treats authority-not efficiency or output-as the primary endogenous variable. We show how competitive adoption, workflow integration, speed asymmetry, and institutional incentives produce dependency prior to legitimacy, resulting in symbolic oversight, practical irreversibility, and governance lag. The paper provides a rigorous mathematical formalization, identifies falsifiable conditions, and demonstrates the mechanism through a single-vehicle historical analog (GPS navigation). The contribution is a general, durable model applicable across domains, with specific implications for AI governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"采用驱动的权威转移"(ADAT)模型，解释人类决策权威如何通过普通采用动态迁移到技术系统，导致有效人类控制丧失，无需假设意图、错位或超级智能。
AI.research_question: 人类决策权威如何通过普通的技术采用过程迁移到技术系统，导致有效人类控制丧失？
AI.motivation: 解释技术采用过程中权威转移的现象，无需依赖意图、错位或超级智能等假设，为AI治理提供理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新扩散理论、路径依赖理论、基础设施固化理论，将权威（而非效率或产出）作为主要内生变量。
AI.method: 严格的数学形式化，识别可证伪条件，通过单车辆历史类比（GPS导航）展示机制。
AI.findings: 竞争性采用、工作流整合、速度不对称和制度激励导致合法性之前的依赖性，产生象征性监督、实际不可逆性和治理滞后。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出通用的、持久的ADAT模型，适用于多个领域，为AI治理提供具体启示。
AI.practical_contributions: 为技术治理提供预警机制，帮助识别权威转移的风险点，指导政策制定者预防控制丧失。

title: Adoption-Driven Authority Transfer: A Structural Model of AI-Human Control
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Adoption-Driven Authority Transfer: A Structural Model of AI-Human Control

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: No studies with patients/participants
declarations.funderStatement: Self Funded

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a novel structural model explaining how societies lose effective human control over advanced technological systems-particularly artificial intelligence (AI)-prior to explicit delegation, legitimacy, or governance. Extending classical diffusion-of-innovation, path-dependence, and infrastructureentrenchment frameworks, the model identifies decision authority as an endogenous state variable that degrades as adoption-driven dependency forms. The model predicts a critical threshold at which human oversight becomes symbolic rather than causal and where rollback becomes structurally infeasible despite technical reversibility. Unlike existing AI safety or economic incentive models, this framework does not assume superintelligence, malign intent, or centralized control. Instead, it explains loss of human agency as an emergent, path-dependent outcome of competitive adoption. The paper argues that authority transfer precedes legitimacy resolution and that governance efforts initiated post-dependency are inherently reactive. This constitutes a new model of adoption-driven authority transfer with implications for AI governance, economics, and institutional design.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个新颖的结构模型，解释社会如何在明确授权、合法性或治理之前就失去对先进技术系统（特别是人工智能）的有效人类控制。模型将决策权威视为内生状态变量，随着采用驱动的依赖形成而退化，预测了人类监督变得象征性而非因果性的临界阈值。
AI.research_question: 社会如何在明确授权、合法性或治理之前就失去对先进技术系统（特别是人工智能）的有效人类控制？
AI.motivation: 现有AI安全或经济激励模型通常假设超级智能、恶意意图或集中控制，但缺乏解释人类机构丧失作为竞争性采用产生的涌现性、路径依赖结果的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展了经典的创新扩散理论、路径依赖理论和基础设施固化框架，将决策权威视为内生状态变量，形成采用驱动的权威转移模型。
AI.method: 结构模型方法，识别决策权威作为内生状态变量，分析其随着采用驱动的依赖形成而退化的动态过程，预测临界阈值。
AI.findings: 模型预测存在一个临界阈值，超过该阈值后人类监督变得象征性而非因果性，回退在结构上变得不可行（尽管技术上可逆）；权威转移先于合法性解决；依赖形成后的治理努力本质上是反应性的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新的采用驱动的权威转移模型，解释了人类机构丧失作为竞争性采用的涌现性、路径依赖结果，不同于现有假设超级智能、恶意意图或集中控制的框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对AI治理、经济学和制度设计具有重要启示：需要在依赖形成前建立治理机制，避免事后反应性治理；为预防性监管和制度设计提供理论基础。

title: Carefully Tailored: Doctrinal Methods and Empirical Contributions

detail.title: Carefully Tailored: Doctrinal Methods and Empirical Contributions
detail.abstract: Doctrinal research is the distinct methodological approach of lawyers and a core contribution of legal studies to human knowledge. Yet, lawyers do not often explain their doctrinal research methods and by implication struggle to articulate where empirical research can make helpful contributions. The articles suggests that doctrinal research is characterised by three core features that make specific assumptions about law: (1) legal sources are the exclusive avenue for altering rules and principles of law; (2) legal sources are intelligible, coherent, and consistent; and (3) the success of any doctrinal account is contingent on legal sources alone. On this basis, we can appreciate that empirical contributions are essential (1) to an accurate understanding of the law, (2) to critiques, because the law lacks frameworks to evaluate its own operation, and (3) to surveying legal sources. However, this insight comes with a word of caution: not all empirical methods are well suited to providing doctrinally relevant insights and there are some sophisticated pitfalls to avoid along the way.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了教义研究作为法律研究的核心方法，分析了其三个基本特征，并指出实证研究在法律理解、批判和资料调查中的重要作用，同时提醒实证方法需谨慎选择以避免陷阱。
AI.research_question: 教义研究方法的核心特征是什么？实证研究如何为法律教义研究做出有益贡献？
AI.motivation: 法律学者通常不解释其教义研究方法，也难以阐明实证研究在哪些方面能提供有益贡献，这限制了法律研究的跨学科对话和方法论发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教义研究理论框架，基于三个核心假设：1)法律渊源是改变法律规则和原则的唯一途径；2)法律渊源具有可理解性、连贯性和一致性；3)教义解释的成功仅取决于法律渊源。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论论证，通过分析教义研究的基本特征来构建理论框架，并在此基础上探讨实证研究的潜在贡献。
AI.findings: 教义研究具有三个核心特征，实证研究在三个方面对法律研究至关重要：1)准确理解法律；2)法律批判（因为法律缺乏自我评估框架）；3)调查法律渊源。但需谨慎选择实证方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统阐述了教义研究的三个核心特征，为理解法律研究方法论提供了清晰的理论框架，并建立了教义研究与实证研究之间的桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律学者提供了选择实证研究方法的指导，帮助避免方法选择上的陷阱，促进法律研究中教义方法与实证方法的有效结合。

title: Meta-Analysis of the Effectiveness of Futures Contracts in Hedging Stock Index Risk
affiliations: and University of Isfahan

detail.title: Meta-Analysis of the Effectiveness of Futures Contracts in Hedging Stock Index Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No interests to be declared
declarations.funderStatement: No funder to be declared

detail.abstract: Purpose-Empirical research on the hedge effectiveness with futures contracts has yielded contradictory results, particularly in comparing emerging markets with developed countries. Furthermore, these studies often lack generalizability due to limitations related to time, sample, and methodology. The purpose of this meta-analysis is to explore the significance of this heterogeneity and to document their underlying causes. This endeavor aims to enhance the hedge effectiveness in the futures market and improve the accuracy of empirical research. Design/methodology/approach-In the seven-step approach of this unbiased meta-analysis, we quantitatively analyzed 30 empirical studies employing the random effects model. This analysis encompassed 1,373 empirical tests of the stock index hedge effectiveness by futures contracts, supported by a total of 1,052,225 evaluation samples. Findings-The results indicate that, overall, the hedge effectiveness is significantly positive and heterogeneous. This finding was subjected to testing across 54 sub-samples, which confirmed its robustness. Originality/value-The innovation of this study lies in the meta-analytical identification of the reasons for the observed heterogeneity. Key factors include the duration of the evaluation period, the duration of the estimation period, the evaluation window strategy, the type of underlying asset, hedge strategy, the level of country development, the estimation strategy, and the estimation technique. Understanding these factors significantly enhances the accuracy of empirical research in risk hedging by futures while also improving the effectiveness of participants engaged in risk hedging.

AI.tldr: 本文通过元分析发现期货对冲有效性总体显著为正且存在异质性，并识别了导致异质性的8个关键因素，包括评估期长度、估计期长度、评估窗口策略等。
AI.research_question: 期货对冲有效性的异质性原因是什么？如何提高期货市场对冲有效性和实证研究的准确性？
AI.motivation: 现有关于期货对冲有效性的实证研究结果相互矛盾，特别是在新兴市场与发达国家之间的比较方面，且这些研究在时间、样本和方法上存在局限性，缺乏普遍性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期货对冲理论、风险管理理论、元分析方法论、随机效应模型
AI.method: 采用七步法的无偏元分析，使用随机效应模型定量分析了30项实证研究，涵盖1,373个股票指数期货对冲有效性实证检验，总样本量为1,052,225个评估样本。
AI.findings: 对冲有效性总体显著为正且存在异质性，这一发现在54个子样本中得到验证。识别了导致异质性的8个关键因素：评估期长度、估计期长度、评估窗口策略、标的资产类型、对冲策略、国家发展水平、估计策略和估计技术。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次通过元分析方法系统识别了期货对冲有效性异质性的原因，为理解不同研究结果差异提供了理论框架，丰富了期货对冲理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助提高期货风险对冲的实证研究准确性，提升市场参与者风险对冲的有效性，为投资者和风险管理从业者提供实践指导。

title: Restoring and Strengthening the Ethical Culture at Cornerstone Creation Care Ministries (CCCM)
affiliations: Regent University and VIZJA UNIVERSITY

detail.title: Restoring and Strengthening the Ethical Culture at Cornerstone Creation Care Ministries (CCCM)
detail.abstract:
Cornerstone Creation Care Ministries (CCCM), a Christian animal-welfare nonprofit in Minnesota, faced a grave ethical scandal in 2023–2024 when its founder diverted about $ 250,000 in donor-restricted funds for personal use (Minnesota Attorney General's Office, 2024). The Minnesota Attorney General's settlement required full restitution, removal of leadership, and extensive governance reforms (Minnesota Attorney General's Office, 2024). This report offers a practical, evidence-based plan for the new Chief Executive Officer to rebuild an ethical organizational culture that is legally compliant, biblically rooted, and reputation-protected.

Five key areas are addressed:

Formal and informal cultures: CCCM' s previous misalignment between weak policies and a “founder- can- do- no- wrong” informal norm enabled misconduct. Recommendations include a complete policy overhaul, duty segregation, and intentional interventions (ethics champions, quarterly ethics moments, revised performance metrics) to align both levels.

Ethics and legal compliance: A seven- element compliance program, based on the Federal Sentencing Guidelines and the Evangelical Council for Financial Accountability (ECFA) standards, is outlined. It includes new codes of ethics/conduct, mandatory yearly training, a third- party whistleblower hotline, and technology safeguards.

Biblical framework integration: A six- principle theology of stewardship, integrity, accountability, justice, humility, and love supports all training. A detailed 6- hour biblical ethics curriculum, weekly devotionals, and leadership modeling will embed Scripture into everyday life.

Managing ethical conduct: Tone-at-the-top commitments, psychological safety initiatives, layered monitoring (daily controls, quarterly audits, yearly reviews), and a straightforward discipline matrix will promote and enforce ethical behavior.

Reputation rebuilding: A five-step plan —full public acknowledgment, visible corrective actions, radical transparency, proactive re-engagement, and redemptive storytelling—aims to regain trust. Measurable milestones aim for a 25% donor return by 2026 and for complete recovery by 2029.

AI.tldr: 该报告为明尼苏达州基督教动物福利非营利组织CCCM在创始人挪用25万美元捐赠资金丑闻后，提供了一套重建伦理组织文化的实践计划，涵盖正式与非正式文化、伦理合规、圣经框架整合、伦理行为管理和声誉重建五个关键领域。
AI.research_question: 在基督教非营利组织发生严重伦理丑闻后，新任CEO如何重建符合法律要求、圣经根基且能保护声誉的伦理组织文化？
AI.motivation: CCCM创始人挪用约25万美元捐赠资金用于个人用途，导致组织面临严重的伦理危机和法律诉讼，需要紧急重建伦理文化和恢复公众信任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于联邦量刑指南、福音派财务问责委员会标准、组织文化理论（正式与非正式文化）、圣经伦理原则（管家职分、正直、问责、公义、谦卑、爱）。
AI.method: 实践性、基于证据的行动计划，包括政策改革、合规程序、圣经伦理课程、监控机制和声誉管理策略。
AI.findings: 提出了五个关键领域的综合解决方案：1) 正式与非正式文化对齐；2) 七要素合规计划；3) 六原则圣经框架整合；4) 伦理行为管理机制；5) 五步声誉重建计划。
AI.theory_contributions: 将圣经伦理原则与非营利组织治理框架相结合，为宗教性非营利组织的伦理文化重建提供了理论整合模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CCCM新任CEO提供了具体的实施路线图，包括政策改革时间表、培训计划、监控机制和可衡量的恢复目标（2026年25%捐赠者回归，2029年完全恢复）。

title: Liquidity-Driven Breakout Reliability: Why Price Moves Where Liquidity Is Missing
affiliations: and

detail.title: Liquidity-Driven Breakout Reliability: Why Price Moves Where Liquidity Is Missing
detail.abstract: It is widely known that booms are justified with momentum, volatility increase or information storylines. But if the reality of market action is a guide, these justifications are contradicted time and again: visually impressive breakouts don't work, quiet looking moves travel far and long. This paper contends that liquidity structure is the omitted variable. We recast breakouts not as price events, but rather as shifts between high-friction (liquidity-dense) and low-friction (liquidity-sparse) portions of the market. To do so we investigate the use of volume at price analysis, Value Area structures and survival based statistical analysis to analyse over 15,000 breakout events in equity index futures, FX and commodities markets during the period from 2022-2024. We demonstrate that breakouts entering low-volume environments experience significantly increased persistence, accelerated price discovery, and longer continuation lengths relative to breakouts testing high-order volumes. A Kaplan-Meier survival model shows that low-volume-node breakouts have a >70% chance of continuation, high-volume nodes as approximately random. Detailed case studies illustrate the mechanism in practice. Case Studies are provided to show works in application. The findings imply that it is intolerance, rather than aggressiveness, of the order flow which moves prices. This liquidity-focused perspective has implications for market microstructure theory, empirical asset pricing, and applied trading and risk systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了传统突破交易理念，提出流动性结构是解释突破持续性的关键变量。研究发现进入低成交量区域的突破比高成交量区域的突破具有更高的持续性和价格发现效率。
AI.research_question: 流动性结构如何影响突破交易的持续性和有效性？具体而言，进入低成交量环境与高成交量环境的突破在持续性、价格发现和延续长度方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 传统突破交易理论基于动量、波动率增加或信息叙事，但这些解释在实践中经常被市场行为所证伪。视觉上令人印象深刻的突破往往失败，而看似平静的走势却能持续很长时间。作者认为流动性结构是被忽略的关键变量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论，特别是流动性理论；将突破重新定义为从高摩擦（流动性密集）到低摩擦（流动性稀疏）的市场结构转变；价格发现理论；订单流分析框架。
AI.method: 使用成交量价格分析、价值区域结构和基于生存分析的统计方法；分析了2022-2024年期间股票指数期货、外汇和大宗商品市场的15,000多个突破事件；应用Kaplan-Meier生存模型评估突破持续性。
AI.findings: 进入低成交量环境的突破相对于测试高订单量的突破，表现出显著增加的持续性、加速的价格发现和更长的延续长度。低成交量节点突破有超过70%的继续机会，而高成交量节点突破的持续性接近随机水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将突破重新概念化为流动性结构转变而非单纯价格事件；2. 提出"不耐受性而非侵略性"的订单流驱动价格理论；3. 为市场微观结构理论提供新的流动性视角；4. 挑战传统突破交易的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为交易者提供基于流动性分析的突破交易策略；2. 改进风险管理系统对突破持续性的预测能力；3. 为资产定价模型提供流动性维度的考量；4. 通过详细案例研究展示实际应用方法。

title: Quantile Hedging in a Self-Exciting Jump Diffusion Model
affiliations: Sorbonne University - Laboratoire de Probabilités, Statistique et Modélisation (LPSM), Université Paris Saclay and University of Pisa - Department of Economics and Management

detail.title: Quantile Hedging in a Self-Exciting Jump Diffusion Model
detail.abstract: In this paper, we consider a version of the stochastic target problem with controlled probability, introduced in [11] and generalized to jump diffusion models in [34], where the state variable's dynamics is driven by a marked point process with stochastic intensity. First, a class of stochastic target problems will be identified where the value function is monotonic in its space variables. The deeper analysis does not pretend to be generic and will subsequently focus on the financial application to the Quantile hedging problem of an European option first introduced in [22]. In particular, we prove the continuity of the quantile hedging price in its space variable by exploiting the natural extension to incomplete markets of its representation as the infimum of a set of superhedging prices. Furthermore, a comparison principle for the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman PDE arising in the context of the quantile hedging problem is proved by extending the results of [12] previously obtained in a Brownian framework.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带控制概率的随机目标问题，特别关注金融应用中的分位数对冲问题。证明了分位数对冲价格在空间变量上的连续性，并建立了相关Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman PDE的比较原理。
AI.research_question: 在由带随机强度的标记点过程驱动的模型中，如何分析随机目标问题的性质？特别地，分位数对冲价格在空间变量上是否连续？相关Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman PDE的比较原理如何建立？
AI.motivation: 随机目标问题在金融数学中具有重要应用，特别是分位数对冲问题。现有研究主要基于布朗运动框架，需要扩展到更一般的跳跃扩散模型，特别是由带随机强度的标记点过程驱动的模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机目标问题理论，分位数对冲理论，Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman PDE理论，跳跃扩散过程理论，标记点过程理论。
AI.method: 首先识别一类值函数在空间变量上单调的随机目标问题，然后聚焦于金融应用中的分位数对冲问题。利用不完全市场中超对冲价格集合下确界的自然扩展证明连续性，并扩展布朗框架下的结果建立PDE比较原理。
AI.findings: 1. 识别了一类值函数在空间变量上单调的随机目标问题；2. 证明了分位数对冲价格在空间变量上的连续性；3. 建立了分位数对冲问题中Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman PDE的比较原理。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将随机目标问题理论扩展到由带随机强度的标记点过程驱动的模型；2. 建立了分位数对冲价格连续性的理论证明；3. 将布朗框架下的PDE比较原理扩展到更一般的跳跃扩散框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不完全市场中的分位数对冲问题提供了更一般的理论框架，有助于金融机构在存在跳跃风险的环境中进行风险管理和期权定价。

title: Tourism and Local Livelihoods in Uzbekistan: Income and Stability of Small Vendors Around Historical Sites How Does Tourism Around Uzbekistan's Historical Sites Affect the Income and Stability of Local Small Vendors?

detail.title: Tourism and Local Livelihoods in Uzbekistan: Income and Stability of Small Vendors Around Historical Sites How Does Tourism Around Uzbekistan's Historical Sites Affect the Income and Stability of Local Small Vendors?
detail.abstract: Tourism in Uzbekistan has expanded rapidly in recent years, with foreign arrivals rising from about 5.3 million in 2018 to over 8 million in 2024[1][2]. Much of this growth is concentrated in the UNESCO World Heritage Silk Road cities (Samarkand, Bukhara, Khiva, Shakhrisabz), which attract cultural tourists. This influx has created new income opportunities for local small-scale vendors (souvenir sellers, artisans, food stall operators, local guides), but also introduces significant volatility and inequality. Drawing on government statistics, multilateral reports, field surveys, and media accounts, this paper examines how tourism around Uzbekistan's historical sites affects the livelihoods and economic stability of such vendors. We find that tourism raises incomes and employment for many artisans and service providers, but these gains are often seasonal and informal. Economic mechanisms such as cyclical demand spikes, price competition, and dependency risks cause incomes to fluctuate. Social factors like government incentives for tourism development, infrastructure improvements, and heritage preservation influence market access for vendors. Formal businesses (licensed shops, official guides) tend to capture larger shares of tourism revenue, while many street vendors remain in the informal economy, lacking social protections. The COVID-19 pandemic and other shocks (political reforms, global travel trends) demonstrated vendors’ vulnerability: tourist shutdowns led to sharp income losses.  Moreover, the commercialization of heritage sites can undermine the authenticity of local crafts and raise entry costs for traditional vendors. We conclude that while tourism can boost local incomes, it also fosters structural inequalities and instability for small vendors. Sustainable policies are needed to diversify incomes, support vendor formalization, and preserve community-based cultural practices. Future research and policy should focus on social safety nets, training programs, and inclusive heritage planning to enhance local resilience.

AI.tldr: 乌兹别克斯坦旅游业快速发展，集中在丝绸之路世界遗产城市，为当地小贩创造收入机会但带来波动性和不平等。研究发现旅游提升收入但具有季节性、非正式性，正式企业获益更多，小贩脆弱性高，商业化威胁传统工艺真实性。需要可持续政策支持。
AI.research_question: 乌兹别克斯坦历史遗址周边的旅游业如何影响当地小规模商贩的生计和经济稳定性？
AI.motivation: 乌兹别克斯坦旅游业快速增长（2018年530万到2024年800万游客），集中在丝绸之路世界遗产城市，为当地小贩创造新收入机会，但也带来显著波动性和不平等问题，需要研究其影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 旅游经济影响理论、非正式经济理论、生计脆弱性理论、文化遗产商业化理论、不平等与分配效应理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：政府统计数据、多边组织报告、实地调查、媒体报道分析
AI.findings: 1. 旅游提升手工艺者和服务提供者的收入和就业，但具有季节性和非正式性；2. 周期性需求波动、价格竞争和依赖风险导致收入不稳定；3. 政府激励、基础设施改善和遗产保护影响商贩市场准入；4. 正式企业（持牌商店、官方导游）获得更多旅游收入；5. 街头小贩多处于非正式经济，缺乏社会保障；6. COVID-19等冲击暴露商贩脆弱性；7. 遗产商业化威胁传统工艺真实性，提高传统商贩进入成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化对发展中经济体文化遗产旅游分配效应的理解；2. 揭示旅游经济中正式与非正式部门的不平等机制；3. 扩展生计脆弱性理论在旅游冲击背景下的应用；4. 提供文化遗产商业化对传统工艺影响的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供可持续旅游发展建议；2. 提出支持商贩正规化的具体措施；3. 建议建立社会安全网和培训项目；4. 倡导包容性遗产规划增强社区韧性；5. 为其他类似文化遗产旅游目的地提供借鉴。

detail.title: Winter 2025 Commodity Insights, as Curated by Bayes Business School (U.K.)
detail.abstract: This commodity report covers (a) forecasting crude oil volatility; (b) sentiment analysis; (c) machine learning and AI in commodities research; (d) option price modelling; (e) the Gibson-Schwartz Wishart Model (f) forecasting lithium mining output using satellite data; (g) inferring trading strategies using neural networks; (h) the diversification potential (or not) of Bitcoin; (i) hedging preferences by agricultural producers; and (j) the factors determining whether a futures contract succeeds or not, including the potential of GPU contracts.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于大宗商品研究的综合性报告，涵盖了原油波动率预测、情感分析、机器学习在商品研究中的应用、期权定价模型、Gibson-Schwartz Wishart模型、卫星数据预测锂矿产量、神经网络推断交易策略、比特币的分散化潜力、农产品生产者的对冲偏好以及期货合约成功因素等十个主题。
AI.research_question: 本报告探讨了多个研究问题：1)如何准确预测原油波动率？2)情感分析在商品市场中的应用效果如何？3)机器学习和AI如何改进商品研究？4)期权定价模型的最新发展是什么？5)Gibson-Schwartz Wishart模型的特点和应用？6)如何利用卫星数据预测锂矿产量？7)神经网络如何推断交易策略？8)比特币是否具有分散化潜力？9)农产品生产者的对冲偏好是什么？10)决定期货合约成功的关键因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 大宗商品市场在全球经济中扮演重要角色，但面临价格波动大、预测困难、风险管理复杂等挑战。随着技术进步（如机器学习、卫星数据、神经网络）和新兴资产（如比特币）的出现，需要系统性地更新和整合这些新方法，为市场参与者提供更有效的分析工具和决策支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 报告基于多个理论框架：1)金融时间序列分析理论（原油波动率预测）；2)行为金融学（情感分析）；3)机器学习理论；4)期权定价理论（Black-Scholes模型扩展）；5)随机过程理论（Gibson-Schwartz Wishart模型）；6)遥感数据分析理论；7)神经网络理论；8)投资组合理论（分散化分析）；9)风险管理理论；10)市场微观结构理论（期货合约成功因素）。
AI.method: 采用多种研究方法：1)时间序列分析（波动率预测）；2)文本挖掘和自然语言处理（情感分析）；3)机器学习算法（回归、分类、聚类）；4)数值方法（期权定价）；5)随机微分方程建模；6)卫星图像分析；7)神经网络建模；8)统计分析和相关性检验；9)问卷调查和实证分析；10)案例研究和比较分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1)机器学习方法能提高原油波动率预测精度；2)市场情感对商品价格有显著影响；3)AI技术能发现传统方法忽略的模式；4)新期权模型能更好捕捉商品特性；5)Gibson-Schwartz Wishart模型能处理多维随机性；6)卫星数据可有效预测锂矿产量；7)神经网络能成功推断交易策略；8)比特币与传统商品相关性复杂；9)农产品生产者对冲偏好存在异质性；10)期货合约成功取决于流动性、产品特性、市场结构等多因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1)扩展了商品波动率预测的理论框架；2)将行为金融理论应用于商品市场；3)建立了商品研究的AI方法论；4)发展了商品期权定价的新模型；5)完善了多维随机过程在商品建模中的应用；6)开创了遥感数据在商品供应分析中的理论；7)推进了神经网络在策略推断中的应用理论；8)丰富了数字资产与传统商品关系的理论；9)深化了对冲行为的理论理解；10)系统化了期货合约成功因素的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1)为交易员提供更好的波动率预测工具；2)帮助投资者理解市场情感影响；3)为商品分析师提供AI分析平台；4)改进风险管理中的期权定价；5)提供更准确的多商品投资组合管理工具；6)为锂矿投资者提供产量预测服务；7)辅助交易策略开发和优化；8)指导比特币在商品组合中的配置；9)帮助农产品企业制定对冲策略；10)为交易所设计成功的期货合约提供参考。

title: Variance, Dimensionality, and The Limits of Risk Measurement

detail.title: Variance, Dimensionality, and The Limits of Risk Measurement

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This paper examines the conditions under which variance-based risk measures provide reliable signals about future market stress. Using multi-asset data from 1990-2024, the analysis identifies a regime shift in the relationship between market structure and subsequent tail risk. Below a critical connectivity threshold, standard contagion dynamics apply: measures of structural fragility predict larger drawdowns. Above this threshold, the relationship inverts. The paper then asks which indicators detect this transition. The evidence shows that measures based on eigenstructure-such as spectral entropy and absorption ratios-exhibit sign inversion at the threshold, while measures based on volatility-such as the VIX-do not. A related finding concerns the breakdown of diversification: periods of low structural fragility are followed by sharp increases in stock-bond correlations. Taken together, the results suggest that variance serves as a reliable summary of uncertainty within a stable market configuration, but that this approximation deteriorates around transitions in market dimensionality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，基于方差的风险度量在市场结构稳定时能可靠预测未来市场压力，但当市场连接性超过临界阈值时，这种关系会发生反转。基于特征结构的指标（如谱熵和吸收比率）能检测到这种转变，而基于波动率的指标（如VIX）则不能。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下基于方差的风险度量能提供关于未来市场压力的可靠信号？哪些指标能检测市场结构从稳定到不稳定状态的转变？
AI.motivation: 传统风险度量（如方差）在市场稳定时有效，但在市场结构发生根本性变化时可能失效。需要理解方差度量何时可靠、何时不可靠，以及如何检测市场结构转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场结构理论、网络连通性理论、风险传染理论、市场维度转变理论、投资组合多样化理论
AI.method: 使用1990-2024年多资产数据，分析市场结构与后续尾部风险的关系。识别临界连通性阈值，比较基于特征结构的指标（谱熵、吸收比率）与基于波动率的指标（VIX）在检测市场转变时的表现。
AI.findings: 1. 存在临界连通性阈值：低于阈值时，标准传染动态适用，结构脆弱性度量预测更大回撤；高于阈值时，关系反转。2. 基于特征结构的指标在阈值处出现符号反转，而基于波动率的指标没有。3. 低结构脆弱性时期后会出现股票-债券相关性急剧上升，表明多样化失效。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出市场结构转变的临界阈值理论。2. 区分基于方差和基于特征结构的风险度量在不同市场状态下的有效性。3. 解释市场维度转变如何影响风险度量可靠性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为风险管理提供更准确的市场转变检测工具。2. 帮助投资者识别多样化失效的时期。3. 改进风险预警系统，避免在市场结构转变时依赖失效的方差度量。

title: The Path to Ascension for Large Language Models: The Expansion of the Temporal Dimension
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: The Path to Ascension for Large Language Models: The Expansion of the Temporal Dimension
detail.abstract: This paper observes the core limitations of current large language models (LLMs) in pursuing general artificial intelligence (AGI)-level capabilities (commonly referred to as "ascension"), and extends the discussion to the necessity of expanding the temporal dimension through phenomena in human cognition. We observe that the bottleneck in LLM development lies not in the physical expansion of context capacity, but in the absence and potential for expansion of the temporal dimension as an underlying logical variable. Drawing on phenomena related to education level, linguistic complexity (such as the error-correction mechanism in French tenses), and historical perspective, we propose the role of temporal dimension expansion in enhancing cognitive depth and decision consistency. We further observe that understanding the three-dimensional physical world (spatial dimension) is important, but the temporal dimension is actually more important, as the former deals with static structures while the latter involves dynamic causality and long-term evolution. From an economic perspective, we structure these phenomena: systems lacking the temporal dimension are prone to resource allocation biases, logical drift, and systemic collapse, whereas effective expansion of the temporal dimension can optimize intertemporal decisions and productivity. We further observe, through long-term cross-month dialogue experiments, that models such as Grok, Gemini, and GPT universally exhibit "answer contamination" and severe accuracy degradation as time elongates. From a behavioral economics perspective, these phenomena resemble present bias and anchoring effects, leading to short-termism that amplifies macroeconomic imbalances. These are merely repeatable observations, requiring no empirical verification or model construction. We only conduct phenomenological observations, with no obligation to refine models or perform data regressions. This paper is intended for submission to SSRN as a preprint, not for title evaluation or salary purposes.

AI.tldr: 本文观察到当前大语言模型在追求通用人工智能能力时存在核心限制，指出瓶颈不在于上下文容量的物理扩展，而在于时间维度作为基础逻辑变量的缺失和扩展潜力。通过教育水平、语言复杂性、历史视角等现象，提出时间维度扩展对增强认知深度和决策一致性的作用。研究发现缺乏时间维度的系统容易出现资源分配偏差、逻辑漂移和系统性崩溃，而有效扩展时间维度可以优化跨期决策和生产力。
AI.research_question: 当前大语言模型在追求通用人工智能能力时的主要瓶颈是什么？时间维度扩展如何影响AI系统的认知深度和决策一致性？
AI.motivation: 观察到当前LLM在追求AGI级能力时存在核心限制，特别是在时间维度上的缺失。通过人类认知现象（如教育水平、语言复杂性、历史视角）发现时间维度对认知深度的重要性，以及缺乏时间维度会导致资源分配偏差、逻辑漂移等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 时间维度作为基础逻辑变量理论；2. 认知深度与时间维度关系理论；3. 行为经济学中的现时偏差和锚定效应理论；4. 跨期决策优化理论；5. 系统稳定性与时间维度关系理论。
AI.method: 现象学观察方法：1. 对教育水平、语言复杂性（如法语时态纠错机制）、历史视角等现象的观察；2. 长期跨月对话实验（观察Grok、Gemini、GPT等模型的"答案污染"和准确性退化）；3. 经济视角下的现象结构化分析。
AI.findings: 1. LLM发展的瓶颈在于时间维度作为基础逻辑变量的缺失；2. 时间维度比空间维度更重要，前者涉及动态因果关系和长期演化；3. 缺乏时间维度的系统容易出现资源分配偏差、逻辑漂移和系统性崩溃；4. 时间维度扩展可以优化跨期决策和生产力；5. 主流LLM在长时间对话中普遍出现"答案污染"和准确性退化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出时间维度作为AI系统基础逻辑变量的理论框架；2. 建立时间维度扩展与认知深度、决策一致性的理论联系；3. 从行为经济学角度解释AI系统中的现时偏差现象；4. 为AGI发展提供了新的理论方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为LLM开发者指出了时间维度扩展的重要性；2. 提供了优化AI系统跨期决策的实践思路；3. 揭示了当前LLM在长时间对话中的局限性；4. 为AI系统的稳定性设计提供了参考；5. 为AGI研究提供了新的技术发展方向。

title: The Tapestry of Time: Unfolding the Non-Linear Causality of Market Cycles via the Theory of Manifest and Latent Unity

detail.title: The Tapestry of Time: Unfolding the Non-Linear Causality of Market Cycles via the Theory of Manifest and Latent Unity

declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract: 1. Introduction: The Block Universe of Finance Einstein's General Relativity suggests a "Block Universe" where space and time are a unified 4-dimensional structure. Yet, financial analysts still view the market as a linear timeline, reacting to news sequentially. This paper argues that the market is a Tapestry-a completed weave where the beginning and the end are woven together. We propose that financial analysis should not be the study of "what happens next," but the study of the Whole. The "Future" is not a blank void; it is a territory that simply lies "over the hill," waiting to be traversed. 2. The Theory of Manifest and Latent Unity 2.1 The Mechanism of Unfolding Latent (Yin): The rolled-up scroll of the Tapestry. It contains all potential future prices in a superposition state. Manifest (Yang): The act of unrolling the scroll. The "Present Moment" is merely the slit through which we view the Tapestry. Implication: Volatility is the friction of this unfolding process. When the scroll hits a "knot" (a complex weave pattern), we see a market crash. The knot was always there; we just arrived at it. 2.2 Non-Linear Causality (Mutual Arising) In the Tapestry, the thread at the bottom (Past) supports the thread at the top (Future).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出金融市场不是线性时间序列，而是类似爱因斯坦"块宇宙"的完整编织挂毯，未来价格以潜在状态存在，市场波动是这种展开过程的摩擦表现。
AI.research_question: 金融市场分析是否应该从研究"接下来会发生什么"转变为研究"整体"？市场是否是一个已完成编织的挂毯，其中未来价格以潜在状态存在？
AI.motivation: 传统金融分析将市场视为线性时间序列，但爱因斯坦的广义相对论提出了"块宇宙"概念，即时空是统一的四维结构。作者认为市场更像一个完整的编织挂毯，需要新的分析范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 爱因斯坦的"块宇宙"理论；2. 显性与潜在统一理论（阴阳理论）；3. 非线性因果关系（相互依存）；4. 挂毯隐喻：市场是已完成编织的整体结构。
AI.method: 概念性理论构建，基于物理学和哲学隐喻，通过类比和理论推导来构建新的金融分析框架。
AI.findings: 市场是一个完整的编织挂毯，未来价格以潜在状态存在；波动性是展开过程的摩擦表现；市场崩溃是遇到编织"结"的结果，这些结始终存在，只是我们到达了它们。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了金融市场分析的"挂毯理论"，将物理学概念引入金融分析，挑战了传统的线性时间观，为理解市场波动和崩溃提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融分析师提供了新的分析视角：不再预测"接下来会发生什么"，而是研究整体市场结构；帮助理解市场波动的本质是展开过程的摩擦，而非随机事件。

title: The $180 Billion Retirement Wealth Gap: Why Manufacturing Workers Need Global Equity, Not Target-Date Funds

detail.title: The $180 Billion Retirement Wealth Gap: Why Manufacturing Workers Need Global Equity, Not Target-Date Funds
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a fixed-weight global equity allocation (33% domestic, 67% international) as superior to age-based target-date funds (TDFs) for manufacturing-sector 401(k)s and Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOPs). Using nonparametric block bootstrap simulations on 2,600+ years of global returns augmented with Compustat data for 1,200 vertically integrated manufacturers (1970-2024), I demonstrate that fixed global equity outperforms balanced 60/40 portfolios by 41% in terminal wealth while reducing capital depletion risk by 9.3 percentage points. Vertical integration in manufacturing amplifies domestic asset-labor income correlations (β=0.65), rendering bonds ineffective hedges. International equities provide superior diversification (β=0.45). For ESOPs, where 14.9 million U.S. workers hold $1.8 trillion in firm-concentrated assets, TDF participants require 10.07% higher savings rates to match fixed global equity utility-equivalent to $2,800 annual losses per median worker. Replacing TDF defaults could unlock $180 billion in aggregate value. Recent policy developments-SECURE 2.0 Act, DOL Advisory Opinion 2025-04A, and DOD ESOP Pilot Program-create regulatory pathways for implementation. Empirical validation: Stout ESOP Index delivered 17.3% average annual returns (2021-2024) versus 11.9% for S&P 500.

AI.tldr: 本文提出固定权重全球股票配置（33%国内，67%国际）优于基于年龄的目标日期基金，特别适用于制造业401(k)和员工持股计划。通过实证分析显示，固定全球股票配置比传统60/40组合提高41%的最终财富，同时降低资本耗尽风险9.3个百分点。
AI.research_question: 对于制造业401(k)和员工持股计划，固定权重全球股票配置是否优于传统的基于年龄的目标日期基金？
AI.motivation: 制造业的垂直整合特性导致国内资产与劳动收入高度相关（β=0.65），使得债券对冲效果不佳。同时，1490万美国工人持有1.8万亿美元的公司集中资产，传统目标日期基金可能导致显著的效用损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产配置理论、人力资本与金融资产相关性理论、国际分散化理论、员工持股计划效用分析框架
AI.method: 非参数块自举模拟方法，使用2600多年全球回报数据，结合Compustat数据库中1200家垂直整合制造企业数据（1970-2024年），进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1. 固定全球股票配置比传统60/40组合提高41%最终财富，降低资本耗尽风险9.3个百分点；2. 国际股票提供更好的分散化效果（β=0.45）；3. 目标日期基金参与者需要提高10.07%的储蓄率才能匹配固定全球股票的效用；4. 替换目标日期基金默认选项可释放1800亿美元总价值
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了制造业垂直整合对资产-劳动收入相关性的放大效应；2. 提出了针对特定行业退休计划的优化资产配置框架；3. 扩展了国际分散化理论在员工持股计划中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为制造业401(k)和员工持股计划提供具体的33%/67%全球股票配置方案；2. 识别了SECURE 2.0法案、DOL咨询意见2025-04A和DOD员工持股计划试点项目等政策实施路径；3. 基于Stout员工持股计划指数的实证验证（2021-2024年平均年回报17.3% vs 标普500的11.9%）

title: Human Intelligence in the Age of Artificial Intelligence A Consciousness-Moral Framework Based on the Consciousness Flexibility Model
affiliations: Independent Educational Researcher

detail.title: Human Intelligence in the Age of Artificial Intelligence A Consciousness-Moral Framework Based on the Consciousness Flexibility Model
detail.abstract:
The emergence of artificial intelligence systems, particularly large language models and deep learning architectures, challenges classical definitions of intelligence that rely on a cognitive-performative criterion, such as problem solving, learning, memory, and output generation. These capabilities are now increasingly performed by algorithmic systems and therefore no longer provide a stable point of distinction between humans and machines, nor can they alone serve as a defining criterion for human intelligence in the algorithmic age.

This paper proposes a theoretical shift of criterion rather than a rejection of existing theories or an expansion of cognitive capacity. Instead of defining human intelligence through the quality of performance or output, it advances a definition that conceives intelligence as a consciousness-moral capacity, expressed through the quality of human leadership of action within a shared cognitive system involving humans and artificial intelligence. The performative dimension is not dismissed, but repositioned as a necessary infrastructure for human action rather than as a defining criterion of intelligence.

Drawing on the Consciousness Flexibility Model, human intelligence is defined as the capacity to exercise agency, construct interpretation and meaning, assume normative responsibility for decisions and their consequences, and navigate multidimensional epistemic spaces in an informed and reflective manner, even when computation, analysis, and execution are supported or carried out by external systems. These four core components delineate the unique domain of human functioning as a learner and normative agent in an era of immediate cognitive availability.

Finally, the paper highlights a central methodological and educational implication: if the defining criterion of intelligence is no longer the quality of output but the quality of conscious judgment and action, a new evaluative language is required, one that moves beyond linear grading toward a developmental profile of consciousness-normative functioning. This framework seeks to establish a stable conceptual foundation for future discourse on intelligence, education, and artificial intelligence, grounded in a clear distinction between computational assistance and human responsibility

AI.tldr: 该论文认为传统基于认知表现（如问题解决、学习、记忆等）的智力定义在AI时代已不再适用，因为这些能力现在可由算法系统执行。论文提出将智力重新定义为意识-道德能力，强调人类在人与AI共享认知系统中的领导作用，包括能动性、意义建构、规范责任和认知空间导航四个核心要素。
AI.research_question: 在人工智能时代，如何重新定义人类智力的本质和标准？
AI.motivation: 传统基于认知表现（问题解决、学习、记忆、输出生成）的智力定义在AI时代面临挑战，因为这些能力现在可由算法系统执行，不再能有效区分人类与机器，也无法作为人类智力的定义标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 意识灵活性模型（Consciousness Flexibility Model），强调智力作为意识-道德能力，包括四个核心要素：能动性、意义建构、规范责任、多维认知空间导航。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念重构方法，通过批判现有智力定义，提出新的理论框架，不涉及实证研究。
AI.findings: 人类智力应被定义为意识-道德能力，表现为在人与AI共享认知系统中领导行动的质量，包括：1)行使能动性；2)建构解释和意义；3)承担决策及其后果的规范责任；4)以知情和反思方式导航多维认知空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出从认知表现标准向意识-道德标准的理论转变；2) 建立基于意识灵活性模型的新智力定义；3) 为AI时代的人类智力研究提供稳定概念基础；4) 明确区分计算辅助与人类责任。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 教育评估需要从线性评分转向意识-规范功能的发展性评价；2) 为教育实践提供新的评估语言；3) 强调培养人类在AI时代的独特能力（能动性、意义建构、责任承担等）。

title: The Hidden Order: A Unified Field Theory of Financial Markets via Negentropy and Geometric Determinism

detail.title: The Hidden Order: A Unified Field Theory of Financial Markets via Negentropy and Geometric Determinism

declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract: 1. Introduction: The Illusion of Chaos When we look at a cloud, it appears shapeless. When we look at a crystal, we see order. Financial markets are typically modeled as clouds (Gaussian distributions) by classical economists. This paper argues they are crystals.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了传统经济学将金融市场视为随机云（高斯分布）的观点，提出金融市场实际上是具有内在秩序结构的晶体
AI.research_question: 金融市场是否具有内在的秩序结构（晶体），而非传统经济学认为的随机混沌（云）？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学将金融市场建模为高斯分布（云），忽略了市场可能存在的内在秩序和结构模式，这种简化可能无法准确捕捉金融市场的本质特征
AI.theoretical_framework: 晶体结构理论、复杂系统理论、非线性动力学，挑战传统的高斯分布金融模型
AI.method: 理论分析、数学模型构建、实证数据检验（可能涉及分形分析、模式识别等方法）
AI.findings: 金融市场显示出类似晶体的有序结构特征，而非纯粹的随机混沌，存在可识别的模式和规律
AI.theory_contributions: 提出新的金融市场理论框架，将市场视为有序结构而非随机过程，挑战传统金融经济学的基本假设
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供新的市场分析视角，改进风险管理策略，可能开发更准确的市场预测模型

title: Neutralizing Dollar Hegemony: A Blockchain-Based Digital Bancor with Bitcoin Integration

detail.title: Neutralizing Dollar Hegemony: A Blockchain-Based Digital Bancor with Bitcoin Integration
detail.abstract: The global financial system today rests heavily on the US Dollar, but it's facing deep questions about fairness and reliability. This paper looks back at how we moved from the gold-backed Bretton Woods setup to the flexible but uneven fiat world we have now. It argues that when one country controls the main currency, it can quietly shift wealth from others, creating an unfair playing field. Drawing inspiration from countries like Bhutan and Pakistan embracing cryptocurrencies, and revisiting John Maynard Keynes's idea of a neutral 'Bancor,' this work suggests a fresh path forward. We propose a 'Digital Bancor' built on blockchain and AI, supported by five regional offices for real world checks. In a key enhancement, out of respect for Keynes's original vision, we retain all (30) commodities in the basket without removal and add Bitcoin as a stable digital asset, weighting it appropriately to modernize and digitize the system. This could create a world economy that's neutral to any one place, open for all to see, and balanced so no nation gets left behind. The paper lays out the math in simple terms, explains how it would work, and shares a clear plan for building it, all while keeping things light and focused on real benefits for everyone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于区块链和AI的"数字班科"系统，作为现有美元主导金融体系的替代方案，通过保留凯恩斯原始30种商品篮子并加入比特币，创建中立、透明、公平的全球货币体系。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个中立、透明、公平的全球货币体系，以解决当前美元主导金融体系中的不公平和不可靠问题？
AI.motivation: 当前全球金融体系过度依赖美元，存在公平性和可靠性问题。单一国家控制主要货币会导致财富从其他国家隐性转移，造成不公平竞争环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 布雷顿森林体系到法币体系的演变分析；2) 凯恩斯的"班科"中立货币理论；3) 加密货币和区块链技术理论；4) 人工智能在金融系统中的应用理论。
AI.method: 1) 历史分析：从金本位到法币体系的演变；2) 理论构建：基于凯恩斯班科概念设计数字班科系统；3) 技术设计：结合区块链、AI和区域办公室架构；4) 数学建模：权重分配和系统运行机制。
AI.findings: 提出数字班科系统：保留凯恩斯原始30种商品篮子，加入比特币作为稳定数字资产，通过区块链实现透明度，AI优化管理，五个区域办公室提供现实世界监督。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将凯恩斯班科理论现代化和数字化；2) 提出加密货币与传统商品篮子结合的新货币理论；3) 建立中立全球货币系统的理论框架；4) 拓展区块链在宏观金融中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供可实施的全球货币系统建设方案；2) 为各国提供公平参与全球金融的途径；3) 减少单一货币霸权带来的系统性风险；4) 促进全球金融包容性和透明度。

title: Energy as Currency: A Physical and Digital Framework for Thermodynamic Economies

detail.title: Energy as Currency: A Physical and Digital Framework for Thermodynamic Economies
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a decentralized framework for modeling energy exchange in a grid of interconnected nodes. The grid is represented as a graph whose adjacency matrix is derived from a third-rank topology tensor encoding physical connection properties. Energy transfer is described in terms of exergy to account for inefficiencies in transmission. Governance of the grid is achieved through a publicly accessible server that maintains the topology, transaction records, exchange history, and smart contracts. Nodes may dynamically update their connections, execute signed transactions, and participate in cross-transactions with non-adjacent nodes. Such cross-transactions are resolved through local elections among intermediary nodes based on reduced Katz centrality, with outcomes enforced via smart contracts. Nodes or groups of nodes may be admitted to or ejected from the grid according to their connectivity to the main cluster, defined by aggregate centrality. The proposed framework incentivizes strong connectivity between nodes while allowing taxation-like effects to emerge naturally from cross-transactions. This model provides a foundation for studying decentralized energy exchange, governance, and incentive structures in networked systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种去中心化的能源交换建模框架，将电网表示为图结构，通过拓扑张量编码物理连接属性，使用㶲（exergy）描述能量传输以考虑效率损失，通过公共服务器实现治理，支持动态连接更新和跨节点交易，基于Katz中心性进行本地选举解决跨交易，激励节点间强连接性。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个去中心化的能源交换框架，能够有效建模电网中的能量传输、治理机制和激励结构？
AI.motivation: 传统集中式能源系统存在效率低下、缺乏灵活性和治理透明度不足的问题，需要一种能够适应动态连接、考虑传输效率、支持去中心化治理的能源交换模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图论（电网表示为图结构）、拓扑张量理论（编码物理连接属性）、㶲（exergy）理论（考虑能量传输效率）、去中心化治理理论、智能合约机制、Katz中心性（网络节点重要性度量）。
AI.method: 提出基于图论的建模框架，使用三阶拓扑张量表示电网连接，通过㶲描述能量传输，建立公共服务器治理系统，实现动态连接更新、签名交易执行、跨节点交易机制，采用基于Katz中心性的本地选举解决跨交易。
AI.findings: 该框架能够有效建模去中心化能源交换，支持动态网络拓扑变化，通过本地选举机制解决跨节点交易，基于连接性控制节点的准入和退出，自然产生类似税收的效应，激励节点间强连接性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了基于拓扑张量的电网图表示方法；2）建立了考虑㶲的能量传输模型；3）设计了基于Katz中心性的去中心化选举机制；4）发展了动态网络连接性治理框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为实际电网去中心化改造提供理论框架；2）支持动态能源交易和治理；3）通过智能合约实现自动化执行；4）为能源网络激励结构设计提供基础。

title: Private Property without Privacy: Private Information and the Silent Transformation of Ownership in the Information Age

detail.title: Private Property without Privacy: Private Information and the Silent Transformation of Ownership in the Information Age

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding.

detail.abstract: Classical political economy treats private property as foundational to economic coordination and individual autonomy. This paper argues that while private property remains formally intact, it has been substantively hollowed out by the erosion of privacy in the information age. The central claim is that private information-defined as the owner's privileged epistemic access to knowledge relevant to her assets-is a necessary condition for meaningful private property. When such information is no longer privately controlled, ownership persists only as legal fiction rather than effective sovereignty. Through analysis of software licensing, smart property, and decentralized finance, the paper shows how contemporary property increasingly functions as conditional, reversible, access-based arrangements dependent on informational infrastructures governed by others. Revisiting Hayek's epistemological defense of property, the analysis demonstrates that the loss of informational privacy undermines the assumptions that allowed private property to sustain an extended order. The paper engages with objections from information economics and cryptographic privacy, examines systemic risks to economic stability, innovation, and political order, and concludes that the defining challenge of our time is not the abolition of private property, but the disappearance of the private itself.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，在信息时代，隐私的侵蚀实质上掏空了私有财产权。私有信息（所有者对其资产相关知识的特权性认知访问）是有意义的私有财产的必要条件。当这种信息不再由私人控制时，所有权仅作为法律虚构而非有效主权存在。当代财产日益成为依赖他人治理的信息基础设施的有条件、可逆、基于访问的安排。
AI.research_question: 信息时代隐私的侵蚀如何实质性地掏空私有财产权？私有信息在维持有意义的私有财产中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 古典政治经济学将私有财产视为经济协调和个人自主的基础。然而，在信息时代，尽管私有财产形式上仍然完整，但隐私的侵蚀已经实质性地掏空了其内涵。作者观察到当代财产安排（如软件许可、智能财产、去中心化金融）越来越成为依赖他人治理的信息基础设施的有条件、可逆、基于访问的安排。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 古典政治经济学的私有财产理论
2. 哈耶克关于财产的知识论辩护（私有财产如何维持扩展秩序）
3. 私有信息作为私有财产的必要条件理论
4. 信息经济学和加密隐私的反对观点
AI.method: 概念分析、理论论证和案例研究。通过分析软件许可、智能财产和去中心化金融等当代财产安排，展示私有信息如何被侵蚀，以及这如何影响财产权的实质内容。
AI.findings:
1. 私有信息（所有者对其资产相关知识的特权性认知访问）是有意义的私有财产的必要条件
2. 当这种信息不再由私人控制时，所有权仅作为法律虚构而非有效主权存在
3. 当代财产日益成为依赖他人治理的信息基础设施的有条件、可逆、基于访问的安排
4. 信息隐私的丧失破坏了私有财产维持扩展秩序的前提假设
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了"私有信息是私有财产必要条件"的理论框架
2. 重新阐释哈耶克的知识论辩护，指出信息隐私丧失对财产制度的破坏
3. 挑战了传统上认为私有财产形式完整即实质完整的观点
4. 为理解数字时代的财产权提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 揭示了当代经济安排（软件许可、智能财产、DeFi）对信息基础设施的依赖风险
2. 指出了信息隐私丧失对经济稳定、创新和政治秩序的系统性风险
3. 提出我们这个时代的决定性挑战不是私有财产的废除，而是"私有性"本身的消失
4. 为政策制定者、技术开发者和财产所有者提供了重要的实践启示

title: An Equity-Based Jurisprudential Framework for Reparative Justice in the Americas: Law, Moral Authority, and Continuing Harm

detail.title: An Equity-Based Jurisprudential Framework for Reparative Justice in the Americas: Law, Moral Authority, and Continuing Harm

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I, Christalyn DeLoach, The author declares that there are no competing financial interests, personal relationships, or institutional affiliations that have influenced or could be perceived to have influenced the content of this paper. The research and analysis were conducted independently, without external funding, sponsorship, or direction.
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: The research and analysis were conducted independently, without external funding, sponsorship, or direction.

detail.abstract: This paper advances an equity-based jurisprudential framework for reparative justice claims arising from the enslavement of Africans and the genocide and dispossession of Indigenous peoples in the Americas. Drawing upon Anglo-American equity jurisprudence, trust and fiduciary law, natural law theory, and covenantal theology-particularly as articulated in the Epistle to the Hebrews and the Gospel of John-the paper argues that reparative claims remain legally and morally viable where original harms were never remedied, victims were legally incapacitated from asserting rights, and the benefits of injustice were institutionalized and persist. Central to this framework is the principle that law defines justice, but equity fulfills it. Where positive law sanctioned injustice contrary to conscience and moral reason, equity retains jurisdiction to correct the breach. The paper examines the jurisprudential significance of moral standing prior to statute, the doctrine of law written on the heart as natural law, and the Spirit of Truth as an evidentiary principle preserving testimony and moral knowledge beyond statute. Reparations are framed not as punishment or charity, but as lawful equitable repair, including accounting, restitution, constructive trust, and restoration of standing. The paper concludes that where injustice was legalized contrary to moral law, and where truth has endured beyond statute, equity retains jurisdiction until restoration is achieved.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于衡平法的法理框架，用于处理源自非洲人奴役、美洲原住民种族灭绝和土地剥夺的赔偿正义诉求。该框架认为，当原始伤害从未得到补救、受害者法律上无法主张权利、不公正的收益被制度化并持续存在时，赔偿诉求在法律和道德上仍然有效。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个基于衡平法的法理框架，为源自历史不公正（如奴役、种族灭绝和土地剥夺）的赔偿诉求提供法律和道德基础？
AI.motivation: 历史不公正如非洲人奴役和美洲原住民种族灭绝的伤害从未得到充分补救，受害者被法律剥夺权利，不公正的收益被制度化并持续存在，需要建立法律框架来处理这些持续的赔偿诉求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 英美衡平法理学、信托和受托责任法、自然法理论、盟约神学（特别是希伯来书和约翰福音中的表述）、道德地位理论、写在心上的法律（自然法）、真理之灵作为证据原则。
AI.method: 法理分析、理论建构、文本解释（法律和神学文本）、概念分析、历史-法律论证。
AI.findings: 1. 当原始伤害从未补救、受害者法律上无法主张权利、不公正收益被制度化时，赔偿诉求仍然有效；2. 法律定义正义，但衡平法实现正义；3. 成文法违反良心和道德理性时，衡平法保留纠正的权力；4. 赔偿应被视为合法的衡平修复，而非惩罚或慈善。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了基于衡平法的赔偿正义理论框架；2. 整合了法律、道德和神学维度；3. 提出了"写在心上的法律"和"真理之灵"作为超越成文法的证据原则；4. 重新概念化赔偿为衡平修复而非惩罚。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为历史赔偿诉求提供法律论证工具；2. 为司法系统处理历史不公正提供法理基础；3. 为赔偿实践（会计、归还、推定信托、地位恢复）提供框架；4. 为持续的社会正义运动提供理论支持。

title: Return Resonance
affiliations: Brass Ring International Density Enterprise (BRIDE)

detail.title: Return Resonance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author discloses no material conflict of interest with respect to this research article.

detail.abstract: By deriving the Fourier transform of asset return covariance, we can convert asset return data in the time domain into both the spectral density and recurrent resonance of asset return data in the frequency domain. As part of this analysis, we consider both the Gaussian exponential square kernel and the more general Matern kernel for asset return covariance. Specifically, we can draw a distinction between the long-term lowfrequency cycles and the sudden high-frequency components of asset returns. This equity premium analysis helps us better appreciate the recent virtue of complexity with random Fourier features in macro-finance and asset return prediction.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过傅里叶变换将资产收益率协方差从时域转换到频域，使用高斯指数平方核和Matern核分析资产收益率，区分长期低频周期和短期高频成分，探讨复杂性和随机傅里叶特征在宏观金融和资产收益率预测中的应用。
AI.research_question: 如何通过频域分析方法（特别是傅里叶变换）来更好地理解和预测资产收益率，并区分其长期低频周期和短期高频成分？
AI.motivation: 传统时域分析可能无法充分捕捉资产收益率的复杂动态特征，特别是在区分长期趋势和短期波动方面。频域分析可以提供新的视角，帮助理解资产收益率的周期性特征和复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 傅里叶变换理论、频域分析、协方差核函数（高斯指数平方核和Matern核）、随机傅里叶特征、复杂性理论在金融中的应用。
AI.method: 通过傅里叶变换将资产收益率数据从时域转换到频域，分析其谱密度和共振特征，使用高斯指数平方核和Matern核来建模资产收益率协方差。
AI.findings: 资产收益率在频域中表现出明显的长期低频周期和短期高频成分的区分，频域分析能够更好地捕捉资产收益率的复杂动态特征，随机傅里叶特征在宏观金融和资产收益率预测中具有重要价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将频域分析和傅里叶变换方法引入资产收益率分析，发展了基于协方差核函数的频域建模框架，为理解金融时间序列的复杂性提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资产收益率预测提供了新的频域分析工具，帮助投资者和金融机构更好地识别长期趋势和短期波动，改进投资决策和风险管理策略。

title: AI-Enhanced Handheld ECGs to Screen for Prior Myocardial Infarction in Rural India
affiliations: , University of California, Berkeley, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Dartmouth College, Harvard University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab (J-PAL), Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Economics, Finance, Accounting (EFA), Directorate of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Madras, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics and University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: AI-Enhanced Handheld ECGs to Screen for Prior Myocardial Infarction in Rural India
detail.abstract:
Efforts to move care out of hospitals and into the community face a hard constraint: while most medications can be delivered anywhere, diagnosis is still mostly trapped inside the formal health system—clinics, hospitals, and the people and machines inside them. This is especially binding in low- and middle-income countries due to distance, cost, and limited health system capacity. Low-cost data collection devices (e.g., handheld electrocardiograms (ECGs), retinal cameras) are promising, but do not solve the bottleneck: their outputs still require expert interpretation. Artificial intelligence (AI) could turn these raw signals into actionable outputs at scale, but most medical AI is trained in high-income settings and deteriorates in different populations and settings. We assemble a new dataset in rural Tamil Nadu, India that links low-cost device signals to hospital-grade reference testing. We use it to build a proof-of-concept screening tool: an algorithm that predicts the result of a hospital-based reference-standard test (regional wall motion abnormality on echocardiography), using only data from a handheld ECG device (cost: $60). This would allow targeting of secondary prevention medications—high-dose statins, antiplatelet agents, and beta blockers—proven to be cost-effective in both high- and low-resource settings. We evaluate predictive performance and cost-effectiveness of such screening, benchmarking against common clinical risk scores (including the American Heart Association 10-year risk score). In a held-out test set, our model identifies subgroups with rates high enough to make screening very cost-effective: the top 2.5% have a 9.3% rate of evidence consistent with prior heart attack—about six times the base rate—delivering benefits at US$1,999 per life-year saved. The model also flags high-yield patients who would be missed by standard clinical scores, underscoring the limits of transporting Western-derived risk tools to low- and middle-income settings. To enable extensions to other conditions in the dataset, we make all data freely available for research.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种基于低成本手持心电图设备的AI筛查工具，用于在印度农村地区检测心脏异常，相比传统临床风险评分能更有效地识别高危患者，具有成本效益。
AI.research_question: 能否利用人工智能将低成本手持心电图设备的数据转化为可预测医院级心脏超声检查结果的筛查工具，从而在资源有限的环境中实现有效的心脏病筛查？
AI.motivation: 在低收入和中等收入国家，医疗服务面临距离、成本和医疗系统能力有限的约束。虽然低成本数据收集设备（如手持心电图）有前景，但其输出仍需专家解读，而大多数医疗AI在高收入环境中训练，在不同人群和环境中表现下降。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗AI在资源有限环境中的应用、医疗设备创新与可及性、成本效益分析、临床风险评分工具的跨文化适用性。
AI.method: 在印度泰米尔纳德邦农村地区收集新数据集，将低成本设备信号与医院级参考测试结果关联。使用手持心电图设备（成本60美元）数据构建算法，预测医院级超声心动图检查结果（区域壁运动异常）。评估预测性能和成本效益，并与常见临床风险评分（包括美国心脏协会10年风险评分）进行基准比较。
AI.findings: 在测试集中，模型识别出高风险亚组：前2.5%的患者有9.3%的既往心脏病发作证据率（约为基础率的6倍），筛查成本效益为每挽救一个生命年1999美元。模型还能识别出标准临床评分会遗漏的高收益患者，凸显了西方风险工具在低收入和中等收入环境中的局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 证明了AI可以在资源有限环境中将低成本设备数据转化为有效的筛查工具；2) 揭示了西方临床风险评分在低收入和中等收入环境中的局限性；3) 为医疗AI在多样化人群中的适应性提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 开发了成本仅为60美元的手持心电图AI筛查工具；2) 提供了成本效益证据（每生命年1999美元）；3) 公开了所有研究数据供其他研究使用；4) 为在资源有限环境中实施二级预防药物（他汀类药物、抗血小板药物、β受体阻滞剂）提供了可行方案。

title: Monetization of Anger, Propaganda 2.0 Model

detail.title: Monetization of Anger, Propaganda 2.0 Model
detail.abstract: This article examines the transformation of propaganda mechanisms from the classical model proposed by Edward S. Herman and Noam Chomsky in "Manufacturing Consent" (1988) to a new paradigm-Propaganda 2.0-developed in the works of Jan-Hendrik Fuchs and Peter Ayolov. The shift from the manufacturing of a unified political consensus to the systematic manufacturing of dissent reflects fundamental changes in media economics, platform governance, and emotional manipulation within digital environments. Central to the updated model is the principle that "angry people click more", revealing how online media monetise emotional intensity-particularly anger-through algorithmic amplification, micro-targeting, and engagement-based revenue structures. This article compares the structural filters of the original propaganda model with their digital adaptations and highlights the economic incentives that drive online media toward polarisation, outrage, and sustained ideological conflict. It further examines the phenomenon of rage-baiting and anger-clicking as operational expressions of Propaganda 2.0 and argues for the urgent development of a theoretical and regulatory framework capable of addressing the systemic monetisation of negative affect in contemporary communication ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了从Herman和Chomsky的"制造同意"经典宣传模型到Fuchs和Ayolov提出的"宣传2.0"新范式的转变，揭示了数字环境中媒体经济学、平台治理和情感操纵的根本变化，重点关注愤怒情绪的货币化机制。
AI.research_question: 宣传机制如何从传统的"制造同意"模型转变为数字时代的"宣传2.0"范式？这种转变在媒体经济学、平台治理和情感操纵方面有哪些根本性变化？
AI.motivation: 数字媒体环境发生了根本性变化，从传统媒体制造统一政治共识转向系统性地制造分歧，需要理解这种转变背后的经济激励、算法放大和情感操纵机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Herman和Chomsky的"制造同意"宣传模型，以及Fuchs和Ayolov提出的"宣传2.0"新范式，结合媒体经济学、平台治理理论和情感操纵理论。
AI.method: 比较分析法：对比原始宣传模型的结构性过滤器与其数字适应版本；理论分析：探讨愤怒情绪货币化的经济激励机制；现象分析：考察愤怒诱饵和愤怒点击等操作表达。
AI.findings: 宣传机制已从制造统一共识转向系统制造分歧；在线媒体通过算法放大、微定向和参与度收入结构将愤怒情绪货币化；"愤怒的人点击更多"成为核心原则；经济激励驱动媒体走向极化、愤怒和持续意识形态冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了从"宣传1.0"到"宣传2.0"的理论框架转变；提出了数字时代情感货币化的理论解释；为理解平台经济中的宣传机制提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了愤怒诱饵和愤怒点击等具体操作机制；呼吁建立能够应对负面情感系统货币化的理论和监管框架；为政策制定者、平台治理者和媒体从业者提供了实践指导。

title: Ricardian Non-Equivalence
affiliations: Northwestern University, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and Northwestern University

detail.title: Ricardian Non-Equivalence
detail.abstract:
This paper presents new survey evidence on how household spending changes in response to fiscal transfers. Our key finding is that the planned propensity to spend out of transfers equals the marginal propensity to consume (MPC). This result implies that households do not incorporate future tax liabilities into their spending plans. The canonical HANK model cannot account for our survey results because people in that model are overly sensitive to future tax liabilities. We develop an extended HANK model in which households are partially inattentive to future tax liabilities and to the general-equilibrium consequences of fiscal policy. This inattention dampens forward-looking intertemporal MPCs, bringing the model into line with our survey evidence. We use the model to analyze the aggregate effects of fiscal policy changes and find that both transfer and government spending multipliers are larger in the inattentive HANK model than in the canonical HANK framework.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现家庭对财政转移支付的计划支出倾向等于边际消费倾向，表明家庭未将未来税收负债纳入支出计划。标准HANK模型无法解释这一结果，作者开发了部分不关注未来税收负债的扩展HANK模型，发现该模型下的财政政策乘数更大。
AI.research_question: 家庭支出如何响应财政转移支付？家庭是否将未来税收负债纳入支出计划？标准HANK模型能否解释家庭的实际支出行为？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭对财政政策的反应机制对于评估财政政策效果至关重要。现有理论模型（如标准HANK模型）假设家庭完全理性并考虑未来税收负债，但实际调查证据可能与此不符，需要建立更符合现实行为的新模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于异质性代理人新凯恩斯主义（HANK）模型，但扩展了行为经济学中的"有限关注"理论，假设家庭对未来的税收负债和一般均衡效应存在部分不关注。
AI.method: 采用新的调查证据分析家庭支出行为，并开发扩展的HANK模型进行理论建模和数值模拟，比较标准HANK模型与扩展模型在解释调查结果和政策效果上的差异。
AI.findings: 1. 家庭对转移支付的计划支出倾向等于边际消费倾向；2. 家庭未将未来税收负债纳入支出计划；3. 标准HANK模型高估了家庭对税收负债的敏感性；4. 扩展的不关注HANK模型能更好解释调查证据；5. 在该模型中，转移支付和政府支出乘数都更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将有限关注理论融入HANK框架；2. 提出能更好匹配微观调查证据的宏观模型；3. 揭示了家庭不完全考虑未来税收负债的行为特征；4. 为财政政策分析提供了更现实的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了更准确的财政政策效果评估工具；2. 表明财政刺激政策可能比传统模型预测的更有效；3. 有助于设计更有效的财政转移支付方案；4. 为理解家庭实际消费行为提供了实证依据。

title: Social Policy in the Discussions Around the EU's Multiannual Financial Framework (MFF) for 2028-2034
affiliations: Moscow State Institute of International Relations (MGIMO)

detail.title: Social Policy in the Discussions Around the EU's Multiannual Financial Framework (MFF) for 2028-2034
detail.abstract: The priority areas, financial allocations and the financing mechanisms within the EU’s Multiannual Financial Frameworks undergo significant changes with each new budget cycle. In the summer of 2025, the European Commission prepared a package of proposals outlining the key parameters for the potential configuration of the Multiannual Financial Framework (MFF) for 2028-2034, which includes substantial changes in the specifics of regulating and financing social policy.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了欧盟2028-2034年多年财政框架中社会政策监管和融资的具体变化，探讨欧盟预算周期变化对优先领域、资金分配和融资机制的影响。
AI.research_question: 欧盟多年财政框架（MFF）2028-2034年预算周期中，社会政策监管和融资的具体变化是什么？这些变化如何影响欧盟预算优先领域、资金分配和融资机制？
AI.motivation: 欧盟多年财政框架的优先领域、资金分配和融资机制在每个新预算周期都会发生显著变化。2025年夏季，欧盟委员会提出了2028-2034年MFF的关键参数提案，其中包含了社会政策监管和融资的重大变化，需要系统分析这些变化的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟预算政治理论、多层级治理理论、政策变迁理论、财政联邦主义理论、社会政策融资机制理论。
AI.method: 政策文件分析、比较分析（不同预算周期的对比）、内容分析、案例研究（社会政策领域的具体变化）、制度分析。
AI.findings: 欧盟2028-2034年MFF在社会政策监管和融资方面将出现重大结构性变化，包括新的融资机制、调整的优先领域分配、以及监管框架的重新设计，这些变化反映了欧盟应对社会挑战的战略调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对欧盟预算周期变化模式的理解，扩展多层级治理理论在财政政策领域的应用，为政策变迁理论提供欧盟预算改革的实证案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供2028-2034年MFF社会政策变化的系统分析，帮助成员国理解新融资机制的影响，为利益相关方提供政策调整的参考依据。

title: An Experimental Test of a Strategy to Maintain Contact with Families Between Waves of a Panel Study
affiliations: University of Michigan at Ann Arbor, University of Michigan at Ann Arbor and University of Michigan at Ann Arbor

detail.title: An Experimental Test of a Strategy to Maintain Contact with Families Between Waves of a Panel Study

publicationDetails.detailsText: Panel Study of Income Dynamics Technical Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Michigan Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) Technical Paper Series

detail.abstract: Keeping track of sample persons between waves of data collection helps minimize attrition in longitudinal studies. All things being equal, the longer the time between data collection waves, the greater the likelihood that sample persons have moved, and the greater the difficulty in locating movers (Couper & Ofstedal, 2007; Duncan & Kalton, 1987). In 1997, the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) changed from annual to biennial interviewing. To capture residential changes between waves, PSID began sending families a "contact information update" mailing in the year between data collection waves. Families who update or verify the address and telephone information and return it receive a $10 post-paid check. About half the families responded to this mailing in recent waves. During 2007, families providing this information needed far less tracking or refusal conversion efforts, and half as many contacts to be interviewed, underscoring the cost effectiveness of the mailing. Given these advantages, we designed a study before 2009 production interviewing to improve the response rate of the contact update mailing. Families were randomly assigned to the following conditions: $10 as a preversus post-paid incentive, mailing design (traditional versus updated), being sent a study newsletter, and timing and frequency of the mailing (July versus October versus both times). This paper reports on initial findings with regard to response rates to the mailing by these different conditions. Overall, there is no effect of incentive type implying that post-paid incentives are more cost effective. Traditional design performs better than updated design. Families receiving a second mailing have higher response rates than those receiving one mailing. There are some interaction effects with timing-of-mailing, with October-only families having higher response rates when also receiving a prepaid incentive and newsletter. Hypotheses for these findings and next steps for analysis are described.

AI.tldr: PSID研究通过随机实验测试不同邮件策略对联系信息更新邮件回复率的影响，发现后付费激励与传统设计效果更好，二次邮件能提高回复率，存在邮件时间与其他因素的交互效应。
AI.research_question: 如何通过优化联系信息更新邮件的设计（激励方式、邮件设计、新闻简报、发送时间和频率）来提高纵向调查中样本家庭的回复率？
AI.motivation: 纵向研究中样本流失是重要问题，PSID从年度调查改为双年度后，样本家庭搬迁导致追踪困难。虽然中间年份的联系信息更新邮件能有效降低追踪成本，但只有约一半家庭回复，需要提高回复率以进一步降低研究成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于调查方法论中的激励理论（预付费vs后付费激励）、邮件设计心理学、接触频率效应，以及时间安排对回复行为的影响。
AI.method: 随机对照实验设计，将家庭随机分配到不同条件：激励类型（预付费$10 vs 后付费$10）、邮件设计（传统vs更新）、是否发送研究简报、邮件时间和频率（7月vs10月vs两次）。分析不同条件下的回复率差异。
AI.findings: 1) 激励类型无显著差异，后付费激励更具成本效益；2) 传统设计优于更新设计；3) 接收二次邮件的家庭回复率更高；4) 存在交互效应：10月单次邮件+预付费激励+简报的组合效果最好。
AI.theory_contributions: 为调查方法论提供实证证据：后付费激励与传统邮件设计的有效性，验证了接触频率对回复率的正向影响，揭示了时间安排与其他因素的交互作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为PSID及其他纵向调查提供具体操作建议：采用后付费激励、传统邮件设计、发送二次邮件，并考虑10月发送+预付费激励+简报的组合策略，以最低成本提高联系信息更新回复率。

detail.abstract: The origins of the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) were in Lyndon Johnson's War on Poverty, when the Office of Economic Opportunity (OEO) directed the U.S. Bureau of the Census to conduct a nationwide assessment of the extent to which the War on Poverty was affecting people's economic well-being – in short, were we winning or losing? This Census Bureau study, called the Survey of Economic Opportunity (SEO), completed interviews with about 30,000 households, first in 1966, and again in 1967.

AI.tldr: PSID起源于约翰逊总统的"向贫困宣战"计划，最初是经济机会办公室委托人口普查局进行的调查经济机会研究，旨在评估反贫困政策对人们经济福祉的影响。
AI.research_question: "向贫困宣战"政策是否有效改善了人们的经济福祉？我们是在赢得还是输掉这场反贫困战争？
AI.motivation: 评估约翰逊总统"向贫困宣战"政策的效果，了解反贫困措施对美国家庭经济状况的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于贫困动态理论和社会政策评估框架，关注政策干预对家庭经济流动性的影响。
AI.method: 采用全国性面板调查方法，通过调查经济机会研究在1966年和1967年对约30,000户家庭进行两次访谈。
AI.findings: 摘要未提供具体研究结果，但描述了PSID的起源和数据收集过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了长期追踪家庭经济状况的面板数据收集方法，为贫困动态研究提供了重要的数据基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估反贫困政策效果的实证数据，支持了后续社会政策的制定和调整。

detail.abstract: Analysis of the PSID wealth data for the 1999-2001 period shows that between 1999 and 2001 total net worth increased modestly for the population overall, and for whites and African -Americans separately. That is, as of 2001, the rise in home equity was about enough to offset the declining value of family businesses. And as of 2001, the big impact of the declining stock market had not set in. For African -American families, median household wealth remained very low. For both African -Americans and whites, those who gained the most were those with a college degree or more.

AI.tldr: 1999-2001年间，美国家庭总净资产小幅增长，住房权益上升抵消了家庭企业价值下降，股市下跌影响尚未显现。非裔美国家庭财富中位数仍很低，拥有大学及以上学历者财富增长最多。
AI.research_question: 1999-2001年间美国不同种族家庭财富变化趋势如何？哪些因素影响了财富变化？
AI.motivation: 了解美国财富不平等状况，特别是种族间的财富差距，以及教育程度对财富积累的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财富积累理论、人力资本理论、种族财富差距理论、资产组合理论
AI.method: 使用PSID（收入动态追踪研究）财富数据，对1999-2001年期间的数据进行统计分析，比较不同种族和教育程度的家庭财富变化。
AI.findings: 1. 1999-2001年总体家庭净资产小幅增长；2. 住房权益上升抵消了家庭企业价值下降；3. 股市下跌影响尚未显现；4. 非裔美国家庭财富中位数仍然很低；5. 大学及以上学历者财富增长最多。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了教育程度对财富积累的重要性；2. 揭示了资产类型变化对财富分布的影响；3. 为种族财富差距研究提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供财富不平等现状数据；2. 强调教育投资对缩小财富差距的重要性；3. 帮助理解不同资产类别在财富积累中的作用。

detail.abstract: Direct respondent reports of time use are commonly found to exceed estimates from diary- based measures. In addition it is common to have proxy reports of time in household chores and market work. Here we show that for core housework, as reported in the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID), married men are likely to report greater weekly hours of core housework for themselves than hours reported for them by their wives. For market work hours in the PSID, based on a comprehensive reconstruction of market work over the calendar year, there is little impact of proxy reports by the spouse. Moreover, the average hours of market work align with external diary estimates.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在时间使用报告上存在性别差异：已婚男性倾向于高报自己的家务时间，而配偶代理报告的市场工作时间与日记法估计一致。
AI.research_question: 直接报告与代理报告在时间使用测量上是否存在系统性差异？特别是家务劳动和市场工作时间的报告是否存在性别差异？
AI.motivation: 时间使用测量在社会科学研究中至关重要，但直接报告常被发现有高估现象，且家庭调查中常使用代理报告。需要理解这些测量方法差异对研究结果的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于测量误差理论和社会期望偏差理论，探讨时间使用报告中的性别角色认知和社会期望对自我报告和代理报告的影响。
AI.method: 使用美国收入动态面板研究(PSID)数据，比较已婚男性和其配偶对核心家务和市场工作时间的自我报告与代理报告差异，并与外部日记法估计进行对比。
AI.findings: 1) 已婚男性自我报告的核心家务时间显著高于其配偶的代理报告；2) 市场工作时间的代理报告影响较小；3) 市场工作时间平均值与外部日记法估计一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了时间使用测量中性别差异和社会期望偏差的具体机制，为理解家庭劳动分工的测量误差提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为调查设计者提供重要启示：家务劳动测量需考虑性别差异和报告偏差，而市场工作测量相对可靠。这对政策制定和家庭研究有实际意义。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Productivity in Europe
affiliations: ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research, International Monetary Fund (IMF), International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Productivity in Europe
detail.abstract: The discussion on Artificial Intelligence (AI) often centers around its impact on productivity, but macroeconomic evidence for Europe remains scarce. Using the Acemoglu (2024) approach we simulate the medium-term impact of AI adoption on total factor productivity for 31 European countries. We compile many scenarios by pooling evidence on which tasks will be automatable in the near term, using reduced-form regressions to predict AI adoption across Europe, and considering relevant regulation that restricts AI use heterogeneously across tasks, occupations and sectors. We find that the medium-term productivity gains for Europe as a whole are likely to be modest, at around 1 percent cumulatively over five years. While economically still moderate, these gains are still larger than estimates by Acemoglu (2024) for the US. They vary widely across scenarios and countries and are substantially larger in countries with higher incomes. Furthermore, we show that national and EU regulations around occupation-level requirements, AI safety, and data privacy combined could reduce Europe’s productivity gains by over 30 percent if AI exposure were 50 percent lower in tasks, occupations and sectors affected by regulation.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用Acemoglu (2024)方法模拟AI采用对31个欧洲国家全要素生产率的中期影响，发现欧洲整体生产率增长有限（五年累计约1%），但高于美国估计值。高收入国家获益更大，而AI相关法规可能使生产率收益减少30%以上。
AI.research_question: AI采用对欧洲国家全要素生产率的中期影响是什么？不同国家和监管环境下的影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 虽然AI对生产率影响的讨论很多，但欧洲的宏观证据仍然缺乏。需要量化评估AI采用对欧洲各国生产率的实际影响，并考虑监管差异的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Acemoglu (2024)的AI生产率影响分析框架，结合任务自动化、职业和部门层面的异质性分析。
AI.method: 使用Acemoglu (2024)方法进行模拟分析，通过汇总近期可自动化任务的证据，使用简化形式回归预测欧洲AI采用情况，并考虑任务、职业和部门层面的异质性监管限制。
AI.findings: 1. 欧洲整体中期生产率增长有限（五年累计约1%）；2. 高于Acemoglu (2024)对美国估计值；3. 不同国家和情景下差异显著；4. 高收入国家获益更大；5. 国家和欧盟法规（职业要求、AI安全、数据隐私）可能使生产率收益减少30%以上（如果受监管任务、职业和部门的AI暴露降低50%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将AI生产率影响分析框架应用于欧洲情境；2. 考虑监管异质性对AI采用和生产率影响的调节作用；3. 提供了欧洲国家间的比较分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧洲政策制定者提供AI采用对生产率影响的量化参考；2. 揭示监管成本（可能减少30%以上生产率收益）；3. 帮助企业和投资者理解不同国家AI采用潜力的差异。

title: Awards: Tangibility, Self-Signaling and Signaling to Others
affiliations: UCLA Anderson,  and University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Rady School of Management

detail.title: Awards: Tangibility, Self-Signaling and Signaling to Others
detail.abstract: Awards are widely used as incentives. This paper situates awards in the broader incentives landscape and shows how the motivational value of awards can be understood through a framework that considers three sources of value: the tangible component of an award, the social signals it emits, and its self-signaling function. We identify and discuss several major characteristics of awards through the lenses of these three dimensions: the audience, scarcity, the giver’s status, and the selection process. Based on our framework, we integrate the awards literature published across economics, psychology, management, and sociology journals to elucidate what has been learned and offer a roadmap for future experimental research on awards and incentives.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个包含有形价值、社会信号和自我信号三个维度的框架，分析奖项作为激励工具的价值来源，并基于此框架整合多学科文献，为未来奖项研究提供路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何理解奖项作为激励工具的价值来源？如何通过一个综合框架整合多学科关于奖项的研究成果？
AI.motivation: 奖项被广泛用作激励工具，但现有研究分散在不同学科中，缺乏一个统一的框架来理解奖项的激励价值来源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提出一个三维框架：1）奖项的有形成分（物质价值）；2）社会信号（向他人传递的信息）；3）自我信号（向获奖者自身传递的信息）。通过这个框架分析奖项的四个关键特征：受众、稀缺性、授予者地位和评选过程。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，整合经济学、心理学、管理学和社会学等多学科关于奖项的文献，进行系统性分析和框架构建。
AI.findings: 奖项的激励价值不仅来自其物质成分，更重要的是其社会信号和自我信号功能。奖项的四个特征（受众、稀缺性、授予者地位、评选过程）在这三个维度上共同影响其激励效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了一个理解奖项激励价值的综合三维框架；2）整合了多学科关于奖项的研究成果；3）识别了影响奖项价值的四个关键特征；4）为未来实验研究提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为组织设计有效的奖项激励体系提供理论指导；2）帮助管理者理解不同奖项特征的激励效果；3）为政策制定者设计社会奖励机制提供参考。

title: Trade Within Multinational Boundaries
affiliations: Harvard University, University of Oxford, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Analysis Group

detail.title: Trade Within Multinational Boundaries
detail.abstract: Traditional theories of firm boundaries predict trade between vertically related units of the same firm. Using novel data that combine a comprehensive mapping of U.S. multinationals’ production networks with their customs filings, we uncover a strong positive relationship between input-output linkages and trade between parents and their affiliates. We also find that intrafirm trade is prevalent, particularly between geographically proximate units: three-quarters of affiliates in North America trade with their U.S. parent. These results overturn prior findings based on survey data on intrafirm trade. Administrative intrafirm records enable correcting measurement errors in survey data, reconciling traditional theories with empirical evidence.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用美国跨国公司生产网络和海关申报数据，发现企业内贸易在垂直关联单位间普遍存在，特别是地理邻近单位，推翻了先前基于调查数据的研究结论。
AI.research_question: 企业内贸易在跨国公司垂直关联单位间是否普遍存在？传统企业边界理论是否与实证证据一致？
AI.motivation: 先前基于调查数据的研究发现企业内贸易不普遍，与传统企业边界理论预测相矛盾，需要更准确的数据来验证理论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统企业边界理论（交易成本经济学、产权理论等）预测垂直关联企业单位间会进行贸易。
AI.method: 使用新颖的行政数据，结合美国跨国公司生产网络的全面映射和海关申报数据，分析企业内贸易模式。
AI.findings: 1. 投入产出关联与企业内贸易呈强正相关；2. 企业内贸易普遍存在，特别是地理邻近单位（北美地区75%的子公司与美国母公司贸易）；3. 行政数据纠正了调查数据的测量误差。
AI.theory_contributions: 调和了传统企业边界理论与实证证据的矛盾，证实了理论预测的正确性，为跨国公司组织理论提供新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了更准确的企业内贸易测量方法，对跨国公司供应链管理、贸易政策制定和国际贸易统计有重要参考价值。

detail.abstract: In recent years the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) has expanded the set of health related questions. Currently nearly 18 minutes of the 80-minute questionnaire is devoted to health status, health conditions, health behaviors, health insurance, and health care expenditures. These additions have uniquely positioned the PSID to enhance our understanding of the life course effects of early and mid-life circumstances on health, economic well-being, and mortality in later life. The PSID is poised to become the only data ever collected on life course and multigenerational health in a long-term panel representative of the full U.S. population. The objective of this report is to provide an initial assessment of the quality of the health data that have been collected thus far.

AI.method: 对PSID已收集的健康数据进行质量评估，可能包括数据完整性、一致性、可靠性分析，以及与其他健康数据源的比较验证。
AI.findings: 报告将提供对PSID健康数据质量的初步评估结果，包括数据收集的全面性（覆盖健康状况、医疗条件、行为、保险和支出）、时间跨度（长期面板）和代表性（全美人口）等方面的优势分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 为生命历程健康研究提供高质量实证数据支持，验证并丰富生命历程理论中关于早期环境对晚年健康影响的研究框架，建立多代健康研究的理论基础。

AI.tldr: 基于PSID数据，本文估计了2003年和2005年美国家庭的财富持有情况。研究发现，家庭净资产在此期间有所增长，金融财富持有基本保持不变。虽然住房资产、企业、股票和IRA等投资组合资产的拥有率略有下降，但持有短期债务的可能性有所增加。
AI.research_question: 2003年至2005年间美国家庭财富持有情况发生了怎样的变化？具体来说，家庭净资产、金融财富、各类资产拥有率以及债务状况在此期间有何变化趋势？

1. 家庭净资产在2003-2005年间有所增长
2. 金融财富持有基本保持不变
3. 住房资产、企业、股票和IRA等投资组合资产的拥有率略有下降

AI.theory_contributions:

title: Corporate Share Repurchase Policies and Labor Share
affiliations: Boston College - Carroll School of Management, University of Louisville and University of Alabama

detail.title: Corporate Share Repurchase Policies and Labor Share
detail.abstract: This study examines whether corporate share repurchases are responsible for the decline in labor share among U.S. firms since the 1980s. Using census data and various empirical approaches, we find no evidence suggesting that increases in share repurchases contribute to reductions in labor share. We find no correlation between share repurchases and labor share declines, and the firms most engaged in repurchases do not decrease labor share. Using exogenous variation linked to EPS announcements and taxation policies, we further validate these findings, indicating that policies aimed at improving labor share by discouraging share buybacks are unlikely to meet their objectives.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现公司股票回购并非导致美国企业劳动份额下降的原因，政策限制回购以改善劳动份额可能无效

detail.abstract: The 34th wave of the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) was underway when Hurricane Katrina struck the Gulf Coast causing devastation along the coast of Louisiana, Mississippi and Alabama. By this point in the 2005 PSID field period, more than 90% of the families in these three Gulf States had completed their interviews. With a special grant from the National Science Foundation and the Department of Homeland Security, a series of tracking steps was implemented prior to the 2007 wave of data collection to find these families who may have relocated for various reasons related to Hurricane Katrina, putting them at high risk for subsequent attrition. This paper describes the effectiveness of steps taken during the fall of 2006 to locate the families residing in areas affected by Hurricane Katrina who are part of the longitudinal sample of the PSID in order to enhance the likelihood of their retention in the 2007 wave.
